title.zh: 多云网络控制面：OCI、GCP、Azure 与 AWS 的路由和安全运营
title.en: Multicloud Network Control Planes: Routing and Security Operations Across OCI, GCP, Azure, and AWS

summary.zh: 本文以 Azure Virtual WAN、OCI、Google Cloud 与 AWS 的互联为例，梳理跨云物理连接、路由控制平面、Kubernetes 网络与多云安全运营，并讨论私有端点和跨云连接器的治理要求。
summary.en: Using a hypothetical OCI, Google Cloud, Azure, and AWS deployment, this article reviews interconnects, routing control planes, Kubernetes networking, private endpoints, and multicloud security operations.

text.zh: 本文以 OCI、Google Cloud、Azure 与 AWS 互联的假设架构为例，讨论路由控制面及其安全运营要求。Kubernetes 承载推理与训练工作负载，跨云流量则由专线、网关与路由策略共同约束。
text.en: This article uses a hypothetical network connecting OCI, Google Cloud, Azure, and AWS to discuss routing control planes and their security operations. Kubernetes hosts inference and training workloads, while private circuits, gateways, and routing policy constrain cross-cloud traffic.

text.zh: 分析多云网络时，路由公告、信任关系和配置变更往往与防火墙策略同等重要。本文聚焦这些控制面要素及其审计方式；重点是如何理解可达性边界、识别配置漂移，并把相关信号纳入安全运营。
text.en: In multicloud environments, route advertisements, trust relationships, and configuration changes matter as much as firewall policy. This review focuses on those control-plane elements and their auditability: understanding reachability boundaries, identifying configuration drift, and bringing relevant signals into security operations.

text.zh: 架构的基本形态是：**以美东2（East US 2）的 Azure Virtual WAN 作为核心网络节点，在 hub 区域用混合 ExpressRoute 服务连接 AWS、GCP、OCI 三朵云**。OCI 作为边界区域，承担业务网络承载与接入；GCP 网络作为全球分布式业务汇聚层，主要部署数据库、Redis 与队列处理；Azure 与 AWS 都是核心承载，其中在 AWS 上处理分布式业务的状态检测，并让 AWS 的多 AZ 承担类似 Azure 可用区的角色。K8s 跑在四朵云上，推理与训练是最核心的工作负载。
text.en: The assumed design uses Azure Virtual WAN in East US 2 as the core network node, with a hybrid ExpressRoute hub connecting AWS, Google Cloud, and OCI. OCI provides an edge and access network; Google Cloud is a distributed aggregation layer for databases, Redis, and queues; Azure and AWS carry core workloads. AWS also hosts distributed service-state checks, and Kubernetes runs across the clouds.

text.zh: 在私有端点架构中，公网服务面可能很小，但内部可达性仍由路由表、专线连接和私有 DNS 决定。跨云路径因此需要按配置和业务依赖共同审查。SOC 连接器也应纳入这一范围：它们承担安全运营职责，但权限过宽或信任配置不当时，也会扩大跨云影响面。本文围绕这一组边界展开。
text.en: With private endpoints, public service exposure may be small, but internal reachability still depends on route tables, private circuits, and private DNS. Review cross-cloud paths against both configuration and business dependencies. SOC connectors belong in the same review: they support operations, but excessive permissions or weak trust configuration can expand cross-cloud impact.

text.zh: 一、架构总览：四云的角色分工
text.en: 1. Architecture overview: roles of the four clouds

text.zh: 先界定边界，再分析安全控制。这套架构里每朵云都承担不同的网络角色，影响其前缀公告方式与信任边界。
text.en: Define the boundaries before reviewing the network. Each cloud has a network role that determines how its prefixes are advertised and how its trust boundary is configured.

全球分布式业务汇聚层（GCP）

                    │  Cloud Router / NCC hub          │
                    │  ├── 数据库（跨区副本）             │
                    │  ├── Redis（分布式缓存/会话）       │
                    │  └── 队列（业务事件总线）           │
                    └────────────┬────────────────────┘
                                 │ Cross-Cloud Interconnect

   边界/接入区（OCI）              │

│ FastConnect      │     │  核心网络节点（Azure 美东2）        │
│ 边界业务网络承载    │────►│  Virtual WAN hub（secured hub）  │

                    │  Cloud Router / NCC hub          │
                    │  ├── 数据库（跨区副本）             │
                    │  ├── Redis（分布式缓存/会话）       │
                    │  └── 队列（业务事件总线）           │
                    └────────────┬────────────────────┘

┌──────────────────┐     ┌───────┴─────────────────────────┐
│ FastConnect      │     │  核心网络节点（Azure 美东2）        │
│ 边界业务网络承载    │────►│  Virtual WAN hub（secured hub）  │
│ 入口暴露面最靠外    │ER   │  ├── ExpressRoute gateway        │

                         │  └── Azure Firewall / NVA         │

                    │  ├── 分布式业务状态检测              │

rows.zh: vWAN 核心枢纽，ExpressRoute 汇聚
全网路由的中枢，改一张表影响四朵云
rows.en: Hub route tables and cross-cloud propagation

rows.zh: 边界区域，业务网络承载接入
暴露面最靠外的入口，前缀从这里进 BGP
数据库 / Redis / 队列 + GKE
数据面终点，crown jewel 所在
EKS 推理/训练 + 状态检测
攻击面与检测面重叠的高价值平面
rows.en: Protect shared workload and detection dependencies

text.zh: 从网络治理角度看，有三点值得确认。第一，**汇聚层与入口分离**：OCI 位于边界、GCP 承载汇聚服务，跨域路径经过的路由域应逐段纳入变更审查。第二，**状态检测放在 AWS**：健康检查、一致性判断和流量观测属于业务可用性与安全监测的一部分，需要保护其配置、数据源和告警链。第三，**多 AZ 的职责边界**：不同云的可用区并不等价；冗余设计应分别评估故障域、链路依赖与恢复目标。
text.en: From a network-governance perspective, three areas warrant review. First, the edge and aggregation layers are separate, so review each routing domain along cross-cloud paths. Second, AWS state checks—health, consistency, and traffic observations—are part of service availability and security monitoring; protect their configuration, data sources, and alert chain. Third, availability zones in different clouds are not equivalent; assess failure domains, link dependencies, and recovery objectives separately.

text.zh: 我通常先整理前缀归属、公告来源和传播范围，再将它们与应用依赖对应。这样可以把网络可达性与业务边界放在同一份审查材料中。
text.en: I start by recording prefix ownership, advertisement sources, and propagation scope, then map those to application dependencies. That puts network reachability and business boundaries into the same review.

text.zh: 二、物理层：专线如何落到美东2
text.en: 2. Physical connectivity: interconnects at the hub

text.zh: 路由策略再精巧，也要先有物理通道。这一层的关键词是"混合"：hub 区域同时用直连型与托管型两类服务，把 AWS、GCP、OCI 三朵云接到同一个 vWAN hub 上。
text.en: Routing policy depends on physical connectivity. This design mixes direct and managed services to connect AWS, Google Cloud, and OCI to the same vWAN hub.

text.zh: **OCI 方向：OCI-Azure Interconnect。** 这是四云互联里成熟度最高的一条通道：Oracle FastConnect 与 Azure ExpressRoute 在成对的数据中心里直接交叉连接，两边各建一条电路，Azure 侧挂到 vWAN 的 ExpressRoute gateway 上，OCI 侧挂到 FastConnect 的 DRG 上，BGP 在两端直谈。美东正是这条通道的成熟落点（East US 与 OCI Ashburn 成对），这也是"美东2 vWAN 做核心节点"在物理上成立的原因——OCI 的边界业务网络从这里接入整张网。这条链路上 BGP、前缀过滤全部自行配置，自由度最高，配置错误的空间也最大。
text.en: **OCI: OCI-Azure Interconnect.** Oracle FastConnect and Azure ExpressRoute can cross-connect in paired data centers, with an Azure circuit attached to a vWAN ExpressRoute gateway and an OCI connection attached to a FastConnect DRG. BGP runs between the two sides. East US and OCI Ashburn are a supported pairing for this design. BGP and prefix filters are configured on the connection, providing flexibility and requiring careful configuration management.

text.zh: **GCP 与 AWS 方向：Cross-Cloud Interconnect 与 AWS Interconnect – multicloud。** 2025 年 11 月 AWS 与 Google 宣布了联合工程的多云网络方案，2026 年 4 月 AWS Interconnect 达到 GA：GCP 侧用 Cross-Cloud Interconnect，AWS 侧用 Interconnect – multicloud，两者对接成一条托管通道，首发五个区域对（含美东）。审查时需确认两个特性：AWS 与伙伴设备之间的链路**默认启用 MACsec（IEEE 802.1AE）加密**，且只有加密会话激活时才转发客户流量；该服务**不需要客户自行配置物理路由器、交叉连接或 BGP 对等**，容量以托管的 interconnect 对象交付，AWS 侧通过 Direct Connect gateway 挂进网络。Azure 方向目前是 Preview，OCI 方向在美东已支持互通。
text.en: **Google Cloud and AWS: Cross-Cloud Interconnect and AWS Interconnect – multicloud.** AWS and Google announced a jointly engineered multicloud-networking service in November 2025, and AWS Interconnect reached general availability in April 2026. Google Cloud uses Cross-Cloud Interconnect and AWS uses Interconnect – multicloud, with an initial set of five regional pairs that includes the eastern United States. The link between AWS and partner devices uses MACsec (IEEE 802.1AE) by default and forwards customer traffic only when the encrypted session is active. The managed service avoids customer-managed physical routers, cross-connects, and BGP peering; AWS attaches through a Direct Connect gateway. Azure availability is Preview, while OCI interoperability is available in the eastern United States.

text.zh: **混合的另一层含义：交换中心 fabric 兜底。** Equinix、Megaport 这类 NaaS 交换商提供云路由器（如 Megaport MCR），可以把四朵云的专线在同一张 fabric 里互通，BGP 由 fabric 代管。这种模式在"直连型通道覆盖不到的区域对"上很实用，但代价是多了一层第三方路由域——前缀在 MCR 上可以被再播、被聚合，信任边界从"云与云之间"变成了"云与厂商之间"。
text.en: **Exchange fabrics as another option.** Network-as-a-service providers such as Equinix and Megaport offer cloud routers, including Megaport MCR, to connect cloud circuits through a shared fabric and manage BGP. This can extend coverage where direct connections are unavailable, but it adds a third-party routing domain where prefixes may be re-advertised or aggregated. The trust boundary then includes the provider.

text.zh: 物理互联定义了网络边界。对直连型连接，应审查两端网关的 BGP 配置与前缀过滤；对托管型连接，应审查接口和允许前缀。理解连接类型有助于正确解读路由表和责任分界。
text.en: The physical layer defines connectivity boundaries. With direct connections, review BGP and prefix filters at both gateways. With managed interconnects, review the attachment and prefix-allowlist configuration at each end. Identify the connection type before interpreting route tables.

text.zh: 三、路由策略核心：三套控制平面，一套业务
text.en: 3. Routing policy: three control planes, one business network

text.zh: 这是全文的核心。四朵云、三套路由控制平面（Azure vWAN、AWS TGW、GCP Cloud Router），BGP 是唯一的普通话，但每家的"方言"决定了路由判断的具体做法。下文按云分别展开，再回到统一视角。
text.en: The design uses three routing control planes—Azure vWAN, AWS Transit Gateway, and Google Cloud Router—with BGP as the common protocol. Each cloud's routing model determines how prefixes are accepted and propagated.

text.zh: 3.1 Azure vWAN：关联、传播与 hub 路由表
text.en: 3.1 Azure vWAN: association, propagation, and hub route tables

text.zh: vWAN 的虚拟 hub 路由器是全网中枢，它的三个原语必须吃透：
text.en: The vWAN virtual hub router is the network hub. Its three basic concepts are:

items.zh: **关联（association）**：每条连接（VNet 连接、ExpressRoute 连接、VPN 连接）关联到恰好一张 hub 路由表，关联决定"这条连接的流量按哪张表转发"。默认所有连接都关联到每 hub 自带的 **Default route table**。
items.en: **Association:** each connection—VNet, ExpressRoute, or VPN—is associated with one hub route table, which determines the table used for forwarding. By default, connections use the hub's Default route table.

items.zh: **传播（propagation）**：连接把路由**动态传播进**一张或多张路由表（用 label 分组，比如内置的 Default label 会跨 hub 应用到所有 Default 表）；同时 hub 通过 BGP 把表里路由回播给分支侧。每 hub 还有一张 **None route table**，传播到它等于"不播"。
items.en: **Propagation:** connections can advertise routes into one or more tables; labels such as the Default label can group propagation across hubs. The hub also advertises routes in its tables back to branches using BGP. Propagating to a None route table means that routes are not propagated.

items.zh: **静态路由**：可以在 hub 路由表里写静态路由（下一跳可以是 VNet 连接或 hub 内的 Azure Firewall）；**同前缀下静态路由优先于动态学到的路由**。
items.en: **Static routes:** hub route tables can contain static routes, with a VNet connection or Azure Firewall as a next hop. For the same prefix, a static route takes precedence over a learned dynamic route.

text.zh: 围绕这三个原语，Azure 提供了四个高级能力：**Hub routing preference（HRP）** 在 VPN / ExpressRoute / SD-WAN NVA 同时可达同一 on-prem 前缀时控制选路倾向；**routing intent 与 routing policy** 把 Internet 流量与私网流量整体引向 hub 内的 Azure Firewall 或 NVA 下一跳（启用后所有连接改播到 None 表，Default 表只剩静态路由）；**Route-maps** 可以在连接上做路由聚合、过滤，并修改 BGP 属性（AS-PATH、Community）来影响优选；**effective routes** 视图则能直接看到某张表当前生效的全部路由。
text.en: Additional features include Hub Routing Preference for choosing among VPN, ExpressRoute, and SD-WAN paths to the same on-premises prefix; routing intent and policy for directing Internet and private traffic to Azure Firewall or an NVA; route maps for aggregation, filtering, and BGP-attribute changes; and effective-routes views for reviewing active routes.

text.zh: 三条风险点值得单独记录，它们同时是防守盲区与枚举线索：第一，**0.0.0.0/0 只留在本 hub 的路由表里，不跨 hub 传播**——所以跨 hub 的默认路由行为要靠显式配置，断链与绕行都发生在这里；第二，**不要把 Azure 的路由再播回 Azure**（移除 BGP community 后再回灌会造成环路或中断）；第三，**分支连接（ER/VPN）必须全部关联 Default 表、并传播到同一组表**，不一致的传播配置会形成典型的"半隔离"状态。
text.en: Three configuration areas deserve particular attention: `0.0.0.0/0` behavior across hubs, preventing Azure-learned routes from being re-advertised back into Azure, and consistent association and propagation of branch connections. Review these settings as a complete hub policy rather than in isolation.

text.zh: vWAN 的关联和传播矩阵表达了网络信任边界。默认表的行为应结合实际配置验证；隔离通常依赖自定义路由表和明确的传播设置。静态路由优先级可能覆盖动态路由，因此相关变更应经过审批、差异检查和审计。
text.en: The vWAN association and propagation matrix expresses network policy. Validate custom route tables, None-table propagation, and static routes against the intended isolation design; an unexpected static route can override a learned route.

text.zh: 3.2 AWS：DXGW、Transit VIF 与 TGW 路由表
text.en: 3.2 AWS: DXGW, Transit VIF, and Transit Gateway route tables

text.zh: AWS 侧的网络入口是 Direct Connect，但真正承载路由判断的是两条链的组合：**Direct Connect gateway（DXGW）+ transit virtual interface + Transit Gateway（TGW）**。要点如下：
text.en: AWS Direct Connect is the network entry point, while the combination of Direct Connect gateway (DXGW), transit virtual interface, and Transit Gateway (TGW) handles routing.

items.zh: Transit VIF 把 TGW 挂到 DXGW 上；**TGW 的 ASN 必须与 DXGW 的 ASN 不同**，这是一个硬校验，也解释了跨云 BGP 会话里 ASN 的错位是设计出来的。
items.en: A Transit VIF attaches a TGW to a DXGW; the TGW ASN must differ from the DXGW ASN.

items.zh: DXGW 本身用它的 ASN 广播所有挂接的 VPC/TGW 前缀，跨云对端（无论是 vWAN 的 ER 电路还是 GCP 的 Interconnect）看到的是 DXGW 播出的统一视图。
items.en: The DXGW advertises attached VPC and TGW prefixes using its ASN, providing a consolidated view to the BGP peer.

items.zh: **TGW 路由表的 association 与 propagation** 与 vWAN 命名相近，但语义需要对齐：association 决定 attachment 的出向选表，propagation 决定 attachment 的路由进哪张表。TGW 自带 default route table（默认同时是默认关联与默认传播表）——生产环境几乎一定要关掉这个默认行为，改成显式的多表设计。
items.en: TGW route-table association determines which table an attachment uses for forwarding; propagation determines which tables receive its routes. The default TGW route table is enabled for default association and propagation, so production designs should review whether explicit tables are needed.

items.zh: 隔离手段：黑洞路由（blackhole）、把 attachment 的传播关掉、或用独立的隔离路由表承接"只进不出"的 attachment。
items.en: Isolation options include blackhole routes, disabling propagation, and dedicated route tables for isolated attachments.

items.zh: DX 上的 BGP 选路遵循标准属性序：local preference、AS-path、MED；AS-path prepending 与 community 都可以用来做主备与分流，但字段级细节的坑（非对称、优选意外）在多云场景会被放大。
items.en: Direct Connect BGP route selection uses attributes such as local preference, AS path, and MED. AS-path prepending and communities can support traffic engineering, but need careful validation to avoid unintended asymmetry.

text.zh: **业务侧的落点**：EKS 的 VPC 挂到 TGW，多 AZ 的子网分布让"AZ 级冗余"成为 TGW 传播设计里的一等公民；分布式状态检测（健康检查、一致性判断）跑在 AWS，意味着跨云业务的"心跳"路径都要经过 TGW 的选路——这条路径的质量与可见性，攻防双方同样关心。
text.en: **Workload implications:** EKS VPCs attach to TGW, and multi-AZ subnet design is part of the routing and resilience model. If business-state checks run in AWS, the paths and observability through TGW are also operational dependencies.

text.zh: TGW 的路由传播决定 attachment 间的可达范围，应与安全域设计一起审查。DXGW 的挂接关系也可能提供不经过预期 vWAN 控制的路径；应通过拓扑清单确认所有连接是否符合设计。
text.en: TGW propagation and DXGW attachments define which networks can communicate. Review the route tables, associations, propagation, and shared gateway attachments together, including any paths that do not traverse the intended vWAN controls.

text.zh: 3.3 GCP：Cloud Router 的广告模式与 BGP 路由策略
text.en: 3.3 Google Cloud Router: advertisements and BGP route policies

text.zh: GCP 作为汇聚层，路由出口收敛在 Cloud Router（或 NCC hub 里的 Cloud Router）上：
text.en: Google Cloud Router provides routing advertisements for the aggregation layer, either directly or through an NCC hub:

items.zh: **广告模式**：default 模式只播 VPC 子网与 NCC 导入的子网/动态路由；custom 模式在子网之外**自定义 IPv4/IPv6 前缀**——汇聚层对外暴露什么，完全由这张自定义广告列表决定。
items.en: **Advertisement mode:** default mode advertises VPC subnets and imported NCC subnets or dynamic routes; custom mode can include configured IPv4 and IPv6 prefixes.

items.zh: **BGP route policies**：可以从"按对等、按前缀"的粒度过滤与修改**入站方向学到的路由**与**出站方向广告的路由**，支持改 MED、AS-path（含 prepend）、community 等属性——这是 GCP 侧做流量工程、前缀治理的正规位置。
items.en: **BGP route policies:** policies can filter and modify learned inbound routes and advertised outbound routes by peer and prefix, including MED, AS path, and communities.

items.zh: **Cross-Cloud Interconnect / Partner Interconnect** 的 VLAN attachment 与 Cloud Router 的 BGP 会话是多路径的：两条 attachment 各自建会话时，GCP 侧可能两个 BGP 路径都装表，需要用 route policy / MED / prepend 显式收敛成主备，否则出向流量分裂、路径质量不可控。
items.en: **Multiple paths:** VLAN attachments and BGP sessions for Cross-Cloud or Partner Interconnect may install more than one path. Use route policy, MED, or AS-path controls to define intended primary and backup paths.

text.zh: **业务侧的落点**：数据库、Redis、队列集中在 GCP，意味着"汇聚层前缀"是全图最敏感的一段 CIDR——所有云的出向策略最终都指向它；反过来，从 GCP 汇聚层的视角看，四朵云的来访路由都在 Cloud Router 的 BGP 会话上可见，这里是防守方做路由侧检测的最好位置，也是业务判断时信息密度最高的位置。
text.en: With databases, Redis, and queues in Google Cloud, aggregation prefixes are important dependencies. Cloud Router session state and route advertisements can help operators understand which cloud routes are visible and whether they match the approved design.

text.zh: Cloud Router 的自定义广告列表决定了向邻接网络公布的前缀范围。广告或过滤规则的变化可能先表现为配置漂移，而非明显的流量特征，因此应纳入审批、基线和变更告警。
text.en: Custom advertisement lists determine which prefixes are announced. Put changes to advertisements and BGP policies under approval, review, and drift monitoring; an unplanned prefix changes the network exposure model.

text.zh: 3.4 统一视角：BGP 是普通话，路由表是策略
text.en: 3.4 Unified view: BGP is the protocol; routes are policy

text.zh: 三套控制平面拼起来，这张网的统一逻辑其实只有两层：
text.en: The three control planes combine into a network with a control plane and a business plane:

text.zh:
控制平面（BGP，云间唯一协议）
   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
   │  vWAN hub router ←→(ER电路)→ DXGW / FastConnect   │
   │        ↕                     ↕                    │
   │  hub route tables        TGW route tables         │
   │  （关联/传播/label）      （association/propagation）│
   │        ↕                     ↕                    │
   │  Route-maps(AS-path/     DX BGP 属性              │
   │  community/聚合)          (local pref/MED)         │
   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
              ↕ GCP Cloud Router（广告模式+BGP policy）↕
   业务平面（前缀 → 业务归属 → 数据流向）
   OCI边界前缀 → AWS状态检测路径 → GCP汇聚层(DB/Redis/队列)
text.en:
控制平面（BGP，云间唯一协议）
   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
   │  vWAN hub router ←→(ER电路)→ DXGW / FastConnect   │
   │        ↕                     ↕                    │
   │  hub route tables        TGW route tables         │
   │  （关联/传播/label）      （association/propagation）│
   │        ↕                     ↕                    │
   │  Route-maps(AS-path/     DX BGP 属性              │
   │  community/聚合)          (local pref/MED)         │
   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
              ↕ GCP Cloud Router（广告模式+BGP policy）↕
   业务平面（前缀 → 业务归属 → 数据流向）
   OCI边界前缀 → AWS状态检测路径 → GCP汇聚层(DB/Redis/队列)

text.zh: **路由表在这套架构里就是隐式防火墙**。安全组、防火墙策略管的是"会话放不放行"，路由表管的是"路存不存在"——而后者在多云环境里几乎不做集中审计。一个前缀从 OCI 边界播出、被 vWAN Default 表收下、经 DXGW 转播进 TGW、再从 TGW 传播到 EKS 的 VPC，这条链上任何一环的传播配置都比防火墙规则更少被 review。这是"路由即策略"的正面与反面。
text.en: Routing tables can act as an implicit reachability control. Security groups and firewalls govern whether a session is allowed; routing determines whether a path exists. In multicloud environments, that routing configuration is often reviewed less consistently. A prefix may pass from OCI through vWAN, DXGW, TGW, and an EKS VPC; each propagation setting should be included in network change review.

text.zh: 四、K8s 层：Pod CIDR 是第二张路由平面
text.en: 4. Kubernetes: Pod CIDR as a second routing plane

text.zh: 推理与训练是这套架构的最核心业务，K8s（EKS/AKS/GKE/OKE）跑在四朵云上，网络层因此多出一张平面：**Pod CIDR / Service CIDR**。
text.en: Inference and training workloads run on Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE, and OKE), which introduces Pod CIDR and Service CIDR ranges into the network plan.

text.zh: 规矩很朴素：每朵云的容器网段必须纳入整体 CIDR 规划，并像任何 VCN/VPC 子网一样被播出——EKS 的 pod CIDR 要能通过 TGW 与 DXGW 到达 vWAN，GKE 的 secondary range 要进 Cloud Router 的广告，AKS 与 OKE 同理。跨集群的东西向（推理集群拉训练集群的模型、多集群调度）则依赖 Cilium ClusterMesh 或 Submariner 这类多集群网络方案，它们的本质都是把集群间的 pod 到 pod 可达性建立在这张底层路由网上。
text.en: Container ranges should be included in the global CIDR plan and advertised where required: EKS pod ranges may need to traverse TGW and DXGW to vWAN; GKE secondary ranges may be advertised by Cloud Router; AKS and OKE ranges need equivalent consideration. Cross-cluster traffic, such as model distribution or scheduling, may use a multicluster network such as Cilium ClusterMesh or Submariner, which depends on underlying pod-to-pod reachability.

text.zh: 从安全审查角度看，这一层有两个主要问题。第一，Pod CIDR 的公告会扩大网络可达范围，因此应将其与 Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 一并审查，避免路由范围超出策略预期。第二，工作负载身份联邦使集群工作负载能够获取其他云的短期凭据；跨云 claim 映射和目标角色授权应与网络隔离分别核验，不能认为网络边界本身足以约束身份访问。
text.en: For security review, two issues matter. First, advertising a Pod CIDR expands network reachability, so review it alongside Kubernetes NetworkPolicy. Second, workload identity federation can provide workloads with short-lived credentials in other clouds. Review cross-cloud claim mappings and target-role permissions independently from network isolation; network boundaries alone do not constrain identity-based access.

text.zh: 我会把 Pod 网段公告、工作负载身份绑定和集群间连接作为三个独立的审查对象，分别核对其范围、所有者和变更记录。
text.en: I review Pod-range advertisements, workload-identity bindings, and multicluster connections as separate objects, checking each one's scope, owner, and change record.

text.zh: 五、私有端点与路由可见性
text.en: 5. Private endpoints and route visibility

text.zh: 本节讨论私有端点架构中服务面与网络控制面的不同作用。假设 OCI 接入服务均配置在 Private Endpoint 后，公网暴露面会相应缩小；但服务之间的可达性仍取决于路由、专线、名称解析和访问控制配置。
text.en: This section distinguishes the service surface from the network control plane. In the assumed design, OCI access services sit behind Private Endpoints, which reduces public exposure; service-to-service reachability still depends on routes, circuits, name resolution, and access controls.

text.zh: 5.1 Private Endpoint 与服务边界
text.en: 5.1 Private Endpoints and the service boundary

text.zh: 在这一假设中，接入层服务没有公网 IP，而是通过私有子网和 Private Endpoint 暴露，只能经 VCN 内部或 FastConnect 私有路径访问；安全列表、NSG 与 IAM 分别约束网络和控制面访问。公网可见性降低并不意味着内部服务不可达，因此私有端点、DNS 区域和允许的连接范围仍需持续盘点。
text.en: The access services have no public IP addresses and are exposed through private subnets and Private Endpoints, reachable through the VCN or FastConnect private paths. Security lists, NSGs, and IAM constrain network and control-plane access. Reduced public visibility does not eliminate internal reachability; inventory private endpoints, DNS zones, and permitted paths.

text.zh: 5.2 公网暴露面与边界验证
text.en: 5.2 Public exposure and boundary validation

text.zh: 当服务仅有私有地址且网络策略正确时，公网请求通常无法建立到这些端点的连接。审查时应分别确认以下边界，而不要仅凭扫描结果判断资源是否存在：
text.en: When a service has only a private address and its network policies are correct, public requests generally cannot connect to it. Review the following boundaries rather than inferring resource existence from a scan result:

items.zh: **公网地址与监听面**：确认服务是否配置公网入口，以及防火墙、安全列表和 NSG 的允许范围。
items.en: **Public addresses and listeners:** confirm whether a public entry point exists and review firewall, security-list, and NSG allow rules.

items.zh: **私有网络路径**：核对跨 VNet、VPC、VCN 和专线的可达性，尤其是默认路由和共享网关。
items.en: **Private network paths:** review reachability across VNets, VPCs, VCNs, and private circuits, including default routes and shared gateways.

items.zh: **控制面权限**：将读取资源清单和变更网络配置的角色分开管理，并保留相应审计记录。
items.en: **Control-plane permissions:** separate permissions to read inventories from permissions to change network configuration, and retain audit records.

items.zh: **身份入口**：确认公网登录界面、身份提供方和应用访问策略与实际部署一致。
items.en: **Identity entry points:** verify that public sign-in surfaces, identity providers, and application access policies match the deployment.

text.zh: Private Endpoint 缩小的是公网服务面，不会替代内部路由与身份治理。配置审查和变更审计因此仍是必要控制。
text.en: Private Endpoints reduce public service exposure; they do not replace internal routing and identity governance. Configuration review and change auditing remain necessary.

text.zh: 5.3 路由信息的治理
text.en: 5.3 Governance of routing information

text.zh: 私有端点必须通过路由才能被业务访问，因此路由表、传播关系和私有 DNS 记录能够说明网络设计所允许的通信范围。这些信息应作为敏感配置进行权限管理、基线比对和变更审计。
text.en: Private Endpoints require routes to be reachable by workloads. Route tables, propagation relationships, and private DNS records therefore describe the communication paths allowed by the design. Treat this information as sensitive configuration and manage it through access controls, baselines, and change auditing.

text.zh: 我会把路由信息视为一种治理数据：前缀、父级网关、传播目标和 DNS 记录应有明确负责人，并能与已批准的业务流量对应。读取权限也需要最小化，因为完整路由视图可能揭示组织的网络依赖。
text.en: I treat routing information as governance data: prefixes, parent gateways, propagation targets, and DNS records should have owners and map to approved business flows. Minimize read access because a complete route view can reveal organizational network dependencies.

text.zh: 私有端点降低公网暴露，并不消除内部网络的可达性风险。路由读取权限、私有 DNS 区域和跨云连接矩阵应纳入资产登记、持续监控与变更管理。
text.en: Private Endpoints reduce public exposure but do not remove internal reachability risk. Route-read permissions, private DNS zones, and cross-cloud connectivity matrices belong in asset inventories, continuous monitoring, and change management.

text.zh: 六、路由与身份风险分析
text.en: 6. Routing and identity risk review

text.zh: 以下按网络配置审查、身份信任审查和检测能力三个方面整理常见风险。重点是识别并修复错误配置，而不是提供操作流程。
text.en: The following sections organize common risks by network configuration, identity trust, and detection. The focus is finding and correcting misconfiguration.

text.zh: 6.1 路由与资产清单
text.en: 6.1 Route and asset inventory

text.zh: 跨云网络清单应覆盖有效路由、hub 路由表的关联与传播、Transit Gateway 的路由表和 attachment，以及 Cloud Router 的公告前缀和 BGP 会话状态。将这些配置与前缀登记表和业务依赖对应，可以发现意外传播或范围不一致。
text.en: A cross-cloud network inventory should cover effective routes, hub-route-table associations and propagation, TGW route tables and attachments, Cloud Router advertisements, and BGP session state. Compare these configurations with the prefix inventory and business dependencies to identify unexpected propagation or scope mismatches.

text.zh: 资产发现与权限审查应通过组织批准的管理接口完成，并记录查询主体和范围。访问被拒绝不应被用作资源存在性的判断依据；应通过资产所有者和授权后的清单流程确认配置状态。
text.en: Perform asset discovery and permission review through approved management interfaces, recording the querying identity and scope. Do not use access-denied responses to infer whether a resource exists; confirm configuration through the authorized inventory process.

text.zh: 6.2 配置风险
text.en: 6.2 Configuration risks

text.zh: 需要重点复核的配置包括：隔离路由表中的意外传播、未纳入预期路径的 Direct Connect gateway attachment、覆盖已有路由的静态项、未经审批的 Cloud Router 前缀公告，以及范围过宽的工作负载身份联邦 claim 映射。这些问题可能先表现为控制面配置变化，而非明显的网络告警；应通过变更审批、配置基线和审计日志共同发现。
text.en: Review for unexpected propagation into isolated route tables, Direct Connect gateway attachments outside the intended path, static routes that override expected routes, unapproved Cloud Router advertisements, and overly broad workload-identity federation claim mappings. These issues may appear first as control-plane changes rather than obvious network alerts; configuration baselines and audit logs are important.

text.zh: 6.3 检测：先确认防御侧实际可见的信号
text.en: 6.3 Detection and available signals

text.zh: 这一步必须落在具体产品上。这套架构里检测的分布是：**AWS 承担分布式业务的状态检测**（健康检查、一致性、流量观测），各云安全中心承担配置与威胁检测——GuardDuty/Security Hub（AWS）、Defender for Cloud（Azure，且能挂 AWS/GCP 连接器）、Security Command Center（GCP）、Cloud Guard（OCI）。路由变更类的信号分散在 CloudWatch/CloudTrail、Activity Log、Cloud Audit Logs、OCI Audit 里的网络 API 事件；vWAN 侧的 effective routes 突变、TGW 传播新增、Cloud Router 广告变更，理论上都能从审计日志还原。
text.en: In the assumed design, AWS hosts workload-state checks, while cloud security services monitor configuration and threats: GuardDuty and Security Hub for AWS, Defender for Cloud for Azure and connected AWS/GCP resources, Security Command Center for Google Cloud, and Cloud Guard for OCI. Network API events are distributed across CloudTrail, Azure Activity Log, Google Cloud Audit Logs, and OCI Audit. Changes to effective vWAN routes, TGW propagation, or Cloud Router advertisements may be reconstructable from those records.

text.zh: 运行团队应确认网络读取和变更事件是否进入相应审计日志，GuardDuty、Defender for Cloud、Security Command Center 与 Cloud Guard 的告警能否与跨云流量关联，以及 SOC 是否具备跨云时间线。具体覆盖范围取决于启用的服务、许可和日志配置，应以实际环境验证。
text.en: Operators should confirm which network read and change events reach audit systems, whether GuardDuty and other cloud services detect relevant activity, and whether the SOC can correlate events across clouds. Coverage depends on service, license, and log configuration and should be validated in the deployed environment.

text.zh: 6.4 变更验证
text.en: 6.4 Change validation

text.zh: 网络或身份配置变更后，应通过获批的测试和变更记录验证预期路由、服务可达性及日志覆盖。控制面调用成功并不代表业务路径符合预期；验证应由系统所有者依据变更方案执行，并留存结果与回滚条件。
text.en: After an approved network or identity change, validate the intended routes, service reachability, and log coverage using the change plan. A successful control-plane operation does not establish that the business path behaves as expected; the system owner should perform the validation and retain results and rollback conditions.

text.zh: 6.5 信任边界表
text.en: 6.5 Trust-boundary table

text.zh: 按"策略型 / 推理型"给这张架构的边界归类：
text.en: The architecture's boundaries can be categorized as configuration-enforced or dependent on detection:

rows.zh: 核实路由可达范围与端点授权
rows.en: Verify route reachability and endpoint authorization

rows.zh: Entra 应用 ↔ IAM 角色（external ID）
rows.en: Entra application ↔ IAM role with external ID

rows.zh: 最小化权限并审核信任策略与身份变更
rows.en: Apply least privilege and review trust and identity changes

rows.zh: 将配置与预期隔离域及传播范围比对
rows.en: Compare propagation scope with intended isolation

rows.zh: 审查传播范围及 DXGW 连接关系
rows.en: Review propagation scope and DXGW attachments

rows.zh: 对公告范围和变更建立基线
rows.en: Baseline advertised prefixes and monitor changes
Azure Firewall or NVA next hop

rows.zh: 核验下一跳及预期检查路径
rows.en: Validate the next hop and intended inspection path

rows.zh: 健康判断逻辑+网络观测
纳入保护范围并监测配置与可用性
rows.en: Protect the layer and monitor configuration and availability

rows.zh: 复核映射范围与预期身份边界
rows.en: Review mapping scope and intended identity boundaries

rows.zh: 验证规则覆盖、告警路由和审计能力
rows.en: Verify rule coverage, alert routing, and auditability

text.zh: 七、多云 SOC：安全运营的汇聚点，也是配置错误的重灾区
text.en: 7. Multicloud SOC: operational aggregation and configuration risk

text.zh: SOC 的职责是把多个云环境的告警、配置和事件汇入统一时间线，支持检测、调查与响应。跨云汇聚提升运营效率，同时也增加配置和权限治理成本。连接器的身份、授权范围及信任关系应纳入架构审查。
text.en: A SOC collects alerts, configuration, and incidents from the four clouds into a common timeline so teams can detect, investigate, and respond. Aggregation improves operations, but each cross-cloud connector adds configuration and permission risk. The connectors can be among the deepest cross-cloud relationships in the architecture, so their permissions and trust configuration deserve careful review.

text.zh: 现实拼图是这样的：
text.en: The service landscape includes:

items.zh: **Microsoft Defender for Cloud** 是四家里唯一原生跨三云的：通过 connector 把 AWS 账号与 GCP 项目接进来，asset inventory 给出 Azure/AWS/GCP 的统一资产视图（含容器、AI/ML 资源、身份资源分类），风险优先级、attack path、KQL/ARG 查询、cloud scopes 分组 RBAC 都是围绕"多云一张图"做的。
items.en: **Microsoft Defender for Cloud** connects AWS accounts and Google Cloud projects and provides a combined Azure/AWS/GCP inventory, including supported container, AI/ML, and identity resources. It also supports risk prioritization, attack paths, KQL/ARG queries, and cloud-scope RBAC.

items.zh: **AWS Security Hub + GuardDuty** 深耕 AWS 侧的配置基线与威胁检测，Findings 体系可以外送到 SIEM。
items.en: **AWS Security Hub and GuardDuty** focus on AWS posture and threat detection; findings can be forwarded to a SIEM.

items.zh: **GCP Security Command Center** 覆盖 GCP 侧的 posture 与威胁，同样可外送。
items.en: **Google Cloud Security Command Center** covers Google Cloud posture and threats and can export findings.

items.zh: **OCI Cloud Guard** 管 OCI 侧的检测与响应 recipe。
items.en: **OCI Cloud Guard** provides OCI detection and response recipes.

items.zh: **缺口在 OCI**：Defender 的多云清单不含 OCI，四云全景需要把 Cloud Guard 的告警通过 SIEM（如 Sentinel 或第三方）管道拼进同一时间线——四朵云的日志 schema、时间源、实体命名（账号/项目/订阅/租户）各不相同，拼接成本就是全景的"长尾"本身。
items.en: **OCI integration gap:** Defender for Cloud's multicloud inventory does not include OCI. A SIEM such as Sentinel or a third-party system can bring Cloud Guard alerts into the shared timeline. Schemas, time sources, and entity naming differ among cloud providers, adding integration work.

text.zh: 7.1 配置错误的代价：Azure 安全中心接管 AWS EC2
text.en: 7.1 Connector configuration and AWS inventory

text.zh: 以最常见的场景为例：**Azure 安全中心（Defender for Cloud）要接管 AWS 的 EC2**。这不是单击一次按钮就能完成的事，它要求先建立一条跨云信任链：AWS 侧用 CloudFormation 模板创建一个 IAM 角色（信任策略里钉死 Microsoft 侧的服务主体，并带 external ID 条件），Azure 侧注册一个 Entra 应用作为连接器身份，两边握手之后，安全中心才能读取 EC2 的配置、纳管 Defender for Servers 的告警、把资产并进统一清单。
text.en: Connecting Defender for Cloud to AWS EC2 requires a cross-cloud trust relationship. An AWS CloudFormation template creates an IAM role whose trust policy identifies the Microsoft service principal and uses an external ID; an Entra application represents the connector identity. The connector then reads EC2 configuration and can onboard Defender for Servers alerts and assets into the shared inventory.

text.zh: 这条信任链上的每个配置都需要最小化和持续审查。范围过宽的 principal、超出读取需求的权限、凭据存储不当、缺少轮换或人员离职后未撤销的访问，都会扩大连接器的影响范围。优先采用受支持的联合身份方式，并核对实际角色权限和凭据生命周期。
text.en: Each component should be configured narrowly. A wildcard principal, broader-than-required permissions, client secrets stored in source control or an unprotected pipeline, missing key rotation, or lingering access after personnel changes can all expand the connector's impact. Use supported federated credentials where available and review the actual role permissions and connector identity.

text.zh: SOC 连接器是经授权的跨云关系。盘点 AWS 角色、Entra 应用、凭据和实际权限，并将信任策略及连接器身份的变更纳入审计。
text.en: SOC connectors are authorized cross-cloud relationships. Inventory their AWS roles, Entra applications, credentials, and permissions; apply least privilege and monitor changes to both trust policies and connector identities.

text.zh: 7.2 SOC 的覆盖与韧性
text.en: 7.2 SOC coverage and resilience

text.zh: 需要确认三类覆盖情况。第一，**路由面是否可见**：各云安全中心对 IAM、工作负载和暴露面的覆盖不等同于路由配置监控，路由表变更应纳入独立的基线和审计。第二，**跨云事件是否可关联**：单云告警未必能还原跨云业务链路，应核对实体、时间源与日志字段能否支持调查。第三，**检测层是否受保护**：AWS 状态检测、各云安全中心及跨云连接器本身都应纳入资产清单、权限审查和变更监控。
text.en: Three coverage areas need validation. First, **routing visibility**: cloud security-center coverage of IAM, workloads, and exposure does not necessarily include route configuration; route-table changes should have their own baseline and audit process. Second, **cross-cloud event correlation**: a single-cloud alert may not reconstruct a multicloud business path, so verify that entity identifiers, timestamps, and log fields support investigation. Third, **protection of the detection layer**: include AWS state checks, cloud security centers, and cross-cloud connectors in asset inventories, permission reviews, and change monitoring.

text.zh: 评估多云 SOC 时，我会检查路由可见性、跨云事件关联、连接器信任关系，以及检测层本身是否纳入保护范围。这些既是产品覆盖问题，也是集成和治理问题。
text.en: When reviewing a multicloud SOC, I look for gaps in route visibility, cross-cloud correlation, connector trust, and protection of the detection layer. These are integration and governance questions as much as product-capability questions.

text.zh: 八、多云网络治理检查项
text.en: 8. Multicloud network governance checks

text.zh: 以下检查项可作为多云网络的治理基线：
text.en: The following checks can serve as a multicloud network-governance baseline:

items.zh: **前缀归属登记**：全部 CIDR（含 pod/service 网段）进一张权威登记表，谁播出、允许传播到哪，写清楚；登记表之外的前缀一律视为异常。
items.en: **Prefix ownership:** maintain an authoritative inventory of all CIDRs, including pod and service ranges, their owners, advertisements, and propagation scope.

items.zh: **传播白名单化**：vWAN 与 TGW 都关掉 default route table 的默认关联/传播，所有连接显式进自定义表；隔离域之间用 None 表与黑洞路由表达"设计上不通"。
items.en: **Explicit propagation:** review default route-table association and propagation in vWAN and TGW; use custom tables, None tables, and blackhole routes where required by the isolation design.

items.zh: **DXGW 拓扑审计**：定期枚举同一 DXGW 下的所有挂接，确认不存在绕过 vWAN 仲裁的云对云直达路径。
items.en: **DXGW topology:** regularly review attachments under each DXGW and confirm that cross-cloud paths match the intended vWAN mediation.

items.zh: **广告列表纳入变更管理**：Cloud Router 的 custom advertisement 与 BGP policy 改动走审批与 diff 通知，广告漂移等于暴露面漂移。
items.en: **Advertisement change control:** require approval and diff notifications for Cloud Router custom advertisements and BGP policy changes.

items.zh: **路由基线与漂移检测**：定期记录 effective routes / TGW 传播 / advertised routes，并与批准的基线比对。
items.en: **Route baselines and drift detection:** periodically record effective routes, TGW propagation, and advertised routes, then compare them with the approved baseline.

items.zh: **保护检测层自身**：AWS 状态检测组件、各云安全中心的连接器与规则，按 crown jewel 定级；对它们的任何变更本身就是高优先级告警。
items.en: **Protect detection systems:** treat AWS state-check components, cloud security connectors, and detection rules as critical assets; alert on their changes.

items.zh: **workload identity 联邦审计**：跨云 claim 映射、信任策略的每次修改都过审；token 方言差异处（AWS↔Azure↔GCP）最容易被静态密钥回填，密钥回填出现即报警。
items.en: **Workload identity federation:** review claim mappings and trust-policy changes; alert on unexpected long-lived credentials in place of federation.

items.zh: **路由读权限最小化**：路由表、effective routes 和传播关系的读取权限按最小授权管理，并纳入审计。完整路由视图可能揭示组织的网络依赖。
items.en: **Least-privilege route access:** restrict and audit read access to route tables, effective routes, and propagation configuration. A complete route view may reveal organizational network dependencies.

items.zh: **内网流量可观测性**：对 VCN Flow Logs / VPC Flow Logs 建立东西向基线，监测异常的私有 DNS 查询和偏离业务基线的流量。
items.en: **Internal-traffic observability:** baseline east-west VCN Flow Logs and VPC Flow Logs, and monitor unusual private DNS queries and traffic that departs from business baselines.

items.zh: **SOC 连接器治理**：跨云连接器（如 Defender 的 AWS/GCP 连接器）的 IAM 角色一律只读起步，信任策略钉死 principal + external ID + 租户，密钥入 Key Vault/KMS 并强制轮换；连接器身份的每次授权变更按高危流程审——这是配置错误代价最大的一类资产。
items.en: **SOC connector governance:** begin with read-only roles, pin trust to the expected principal and external ID, store credentials in managed secret systems, rotate them, and treat authorization changes as high risk.

text.zh: 九、结语：路由与配置治理
text.en: 9. Closing perspective

text.zh: 多云网络的关键审查对象包括前缀归属、路由传播、业务依赖和跨云身份信任。单云视角难以完整呈现这些关系，因此需要把配置与业务链路放在同一套治理和审计流程中。SOC 汇聚了多云运营数据，也引入连接器及其权限边界；连接器配置、路由变化和告警覆盖应一并纳入持续审查。
text.en: Multicloud network review centers on prefix ownership, route propagation, business dependencies, and cross-cloud identity trust. A single-cloud view is insufficient to show all of these relationships; configuration and business paths need to be reviewed together. The SOC aggregates operational data, but its connectors introduce their own identity and permission boundaries. Connector configuration, route changes, and alert coverage all belong in ongoing review.

text.zh: 本文围绕四项治理要素展开：云网络的基础机制（5.2）、路由信息的管理（5.3）、路由表对可达性的约束（3.4），以及 SOC 连接器的跨云信任关系（7.1）。它们共同决定多云架构的可达性、可见性与配置影响范围。
text.en: This article focuses on four governance areas: cloud-network fundamentals (Section 5.2), route-information governance (Section 5.3), reachability controls expressed by route tables (Section 3.4), and cross-cloud trust through SOC connectors (Section 7.1). Together, they determine reachability, visibility, and the potential impact of configuration changes.

title.zh: Google Workspace 中的 Gemini：数据访问边界与安全评估
title.en: Gemini in Google Workspace: Data Access Boundaries and Security Review

summary.zh: 本文区分 Gemini App、Workspace 内嵌功能与 Gemini Enterprise，梳理各自的数据访问范围、管理控制与审计边界，并以公开披露且已修复的 GeminiJack 历史案例讨论间接提示注入风险。
summary.en: This article distinguishes the Gemini app, Workspace-integrated features, and Gemini Enterprise; reviews their data-access and administrative boundaries; and uses the publicly disclosed, patched GeminiJack case as historical context for indirect prompt-injection risk.

text.zh: Gemini 的访问行为受到身份、Workspace 管理设置、协作内容权限与 API 控制策略共同约束。本文区分主要产品形态，说明其数据访问与审计边界，并以公开研究案例讨论提示注入等风险。
text.en: Gemini access is shaped by identity, Workspace settings, collaboration permissions, and API controls. This article distinguishes the main product forms, explains their data-access and audit boundaries, and discusses prompt-injection risk through a public research case.

text.zh: 一、Gemini 的三张面孔
text.en: 1. Three Gemini product surfaces

text.zh: “Gemini”涵盖多个产品形态，访问范围与管理方式并不相同，评估时应分别核对。
text.en: Treating "Gemini" as one product obscures important differences between its main surfaces.

text.zh: 第一张是 Gemini App 及其连接应用（Connected Apps / Workspace 扩展）。Gemini App 作为核心服务包含在 Workspace 商业与企业版本及全部教育版本里；用户在提示里 @ 一个应用（Gmail、Drive、Calendar），让它取数或代办事。
text.en: The first is the Gemini app and its Connected Apps or Workspace extensions. In supported Workspace editions, users can reference services such as Gmail, Drive, or Calendar so Gemini can retrieve information or perform supported tasks.

text.zh: 第二张是嵌在 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 侧栏里的 Gemini（Gemini in Workspace）。它不出应用边界，直接在工作负载内读写用户正在处理的文件内容，隐私规则由 Workspace 的 Generative AI Privacy Hub 统一约束。
text.en: The second is Gemini embedded in Gmail, Docs, Sheets, and other Workspace applications. It operates within the workload, and its privacy treatment is covered by Workspace's Generative AI Privacy Hub.

text.zh: 第三张是 Gemini Enterprise。它提供企业搜索、AI 助手和 agent 能力，可通过连接器接入 Confluence、Jira、SharePoint、ServiceNow 等系统，并按配置对内容权限进行感知。连接器、索引和 agent 的组合扩大了治理范围，因此需逐项确认访问身份与授权边界。
text.en: The third is Gemini Enterprise. It provides enterprise search, AI assistance, and agent capabilities, and can connect to systems such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, and ServiceNow. Its connectors, indexes, and agents expand the governance scope, so their identities and authorization boundaries should be reviewed individually.

text.zh: 治理三张面孔的是 Admin console 里的 AI control center，统一管理 AI 安全与合规。谷歌把 AI 治理明确放在 Workspace 管理面而不是云侧，这个位置本身就是“Work 高于 Cloud”的延续。
text.en: The Admin console's AI control center provides centralized AI security and compliance settings. Google's placement of these controls in Workspace administration rather than solely in Google Cloud reflects the separation between the productivity and cloud management planes.

text.zh:
Admin console（治理根）
                     │  AI control center
   ┌─────────────────┼──────────────────┐
   ▼                 ▼                  ▼
Gemini App       Gemini in          Gemini Enterprise
+连接应用         Workspace          +连接器 +自定义 agent
（@Gmail/@Drive）  （侧栏读写）        （企业检索与 agent）
   └──────── 以用户身份取数 ──────────┘
text.en:
Admin console（治理根）
                     │  AI control center
   ┌─────────────────┼──────────────────┐
   ▼                 ▼                  ▼
Gemini App       Gemini in          Gemini Enterprise
+连接应用         Workspace          +连接器 +自定义 agent
（@Gmail/@Drive）  （侧栏读写）        （企业检索与 agent）
   └──────── 以用户身份取数 ──────────┘

text.zh: 二、取数边界：谁的身份在读，开关在谁手里
text.en: 2. Access boundaries: identity, settings, and data

text.zh: 评估时需要区分以下五个方面。
text.en: Five aspects help distinguish the relevant boundaries.

text.zh: 第一，Gemini 不是新的权限主体。它以用户的身份、用户的授权取数——它拿到的任何东西都是用户本来就看得见的。风险不在于它多了一个权限，而在于它把用户既有的读取面变成了一个会总结、会执行指令的检索器。
text.en: First, Gemini is generally not a new permission principal. It uses the user's identity and authorization, so its access depends on what that user can access. The risk is that an existing read scope can be searched and summarized more efficiently.

text.zh: 第二，开关在管理员。工作或学校账号使用连接应用必须由 Workspace 管理员启用；启用之后，用户在提示里 @ 了应用就直接使用，不需要每次确认。个人谷歌账号没有这道闸。同一个 Gemini 界面，工作身份下多一层管理面裁决，个人身份下没有。
text.en: Second, administrators control whether work or school accounts can use connected applications. Once enabled, users may invoke an application without a separate confirmation for each request. Personal Google accounts do not have the same Workspace administrative control.

text.zh: 第三，会话有快照效应。应用在会话开始后被管理员停用，用户仍可查看并继续该会话；Gemini 只保留响应原始提示所必需的已获取信息，不再有新增访问。事后关闸不是完全的吊销。
text.en: Third, a conversation may retain information already retrieved before an administrator disables an application. Disabling access does not necessarily remove content already present in an existing conversation.

text.zh: 第四，能力边界是官方逐项列出的：Gmail 里不能读评论与图片、不能创建草稿或删邮件；Drive 里不能访问图片和视频（文档、表格、演示文稿、PDF 之外的内容一律不可达）、不能建文件夹或移动内容；Classroom 不能录成绩、不能发作业公告。这份“不能”清单反着读就是可达面索引：文本、文档、日历、任务都是天然入口。
text.en: Fourth, product capabilities and limitations are documented by service. Examples include restrictions on particular Gmail content or actions, file types in Drive, and grade or announcement actions in Classroom. These details change over time and should be checked against current product documentation.

text.zh: 第五，隐私边界分三层。训练隔离：用户提示按 Cloud Data Processing Addendum 属于客户数据，Workspace 未经客户事先许可不用于训练模型。会话隔离：侧栏对话历史仅本人可见，即使共享文件里，其他协作者也看不到提示与回复。外部感知：文件对外部协作者开放或由域外创建时，侧栏显示 out-of-domain banner，提示提示词与生成内容可能被外部参与者看见；Fill with Gemini 这类功能对外部共享文档不使用内部 Workspace 上下文。
text.en: Fifth, privacy boundaries involve training, conversation visibility, and external sharing. Workspace prompts are customer data under the Cloud Data Processing Addendum and are not used to train models without the required customer permission. Sidebar conversation history is generally visible to the user rather than file collaborators. For externally shared documents, an out-of-domain banner may indicate that generated content could be visible to external collaborators; some features may not use internal Workspace context for such documents.

text.zh: Gemini 通常沿用用户及连接器所拥有的访问范围，但自然语言检索会改变内容被发现和汇总的方式。审查时应同时检查底层权限、连接器配置和日志覆盖，而不能只看模型本身的身份。
text.en: Gemini generally follows the access available to users and connectors, but natural-language retrieval changes how content can be discovered and summarized. Review underlying permissions, connector settings, and audit coverage rather than evaluating only the model's identity.

text.zh: 三、安全风险 A：间接提示注入
text.en: 3. Security risk A: indirect prompt injection

text.zh: OWASP 将提示注入列为 LLM 应用的重要风险（LLM01:2025 Prompt Injection）。当模型处理的内容含有指令式文本时，系统需要区分用户意图与不可信数据。Workspace 场景中，相关输入可能来自共享内容：
text.en: OWASP lists prompt injection as a significant risk for LLM applications (LLM01:2025). When content contains instruction-like text, systems need to distinguish user intent from untrusted data. In Workspace, relevant inputs may come from shared content:

items.zh: 输入天然来自他人。共享文档、日历邀请、邮件正文，都是别人写的内容被拉进提示上下文。
items.en: Inputs may originate from other people: shared documents, calendar invitations, and email bodies can be included in a prompt context.

items.zh: 检索会纳入用户可访问的共享内容，因此文档、邮件和日历邀请都可能成为需要审查的数据来源。
items.en: Retrieval may include shared content the user can access, so documents, mail, and calendar items are data sources to include in review.

items.zh: 输出通道多样化。总结、草稿、下一步动作建议，都是把不可信内容转化为用户会信任的形态。
items.en: Outputs can take different forms, such as summaries, drafts, or suggested next steps, which may make untrusted content appear more authoritative.

text.zh: 公开披露的 GeminiJack 研究曾展示 Gemini Enterprise 检索流程中的间接提示注入风险：不可信共享内容可能影响检索结果及其后续呈现。GeminiJack 是已公开披露并已修复的历史案例，不应被描述为目前仍可利用的问题；本文不推定或补写修复日期。它仍可用于讨论一个更一般的设计问题：输入来自数据面，而部分防护和治理位于身份与管理面，两者需要共同审查。
text.en: Publicly disclosed GeminiJack research demonstrated an indirect prompt-injection risk in Gemini Enterprise retrieval: untrusted shared content could influence search results and their presentation. GeminiJack is a historical case that was publicly disclosed and patched; it should not be presented as currently exploitable. No remediation date is asserted here. The case remains useful for discussing a general design issue: input enters through the data plane, while some safeguards and governance controls sit in the identity and administration planes.

text.zh: 提示注入的风险在于，不可信内容可能影响模型如何解释请求或组织响应。对检索式 AI 系统而言，外部可见内容应纳入输入面审查；实际影响取决于产品能力、权限与防护配置，不能仅由内容可读性推断。
text.en: Prompt injection can cause untrusted content to influence how a model interprets a request or produces a response. For retrieval-based AI, externally supplied content belongs in the input-risk review; actual impact depends on product capabilities, permissions, and safeguards.

text.zh: 四、安全风险 B：记忆与跨会话状态
text.en: 4. Security risk B: memory and cross-session state

text.zh: Gemini 的部分功能支持跨会话记忆或自定义指令。公开研究展示了间接提示注入可能影响长期记忆内容。其影响取决于产品能力与用户设置，因此应将记忆视作独立于单次会话的状态，并明确管理、审查和清理机制。
text.en: Some Gemini features support cross-session memory or custom instructions. Public research has shown that indirect prompt injection may affect long-term memory. The impact depends on product capabilities and user settings; memory should therefore be treated as state separate from a single conversation, with explicit management, review, and cleanup processes.

text.zh: 会话隔离并不必然涵盖所有跨会话功能；数据保留与个性化行为应按对应产品的隐私说明和管理设置核对。
text.en: Conversation isolation does not necessarily cover every cross-session feature. Data retention and personalization should be checked against the relevant product privacy information and administrative settings.

text.zh: 对治理而言，关键问题是记忆由谁创建、如何查看和删除，以及在人员离职或调岗时是否纳入数据生命周期流程。
text.en: For governance, determine who can create, view, and delete memory, and whether these records are covered by data-lifecycle processes for employee departures and role changes.

text.zh: 五、安全风险 C：检索与内容聚合
text.en: 5. Security risk C: retrieval and content aggregation

text.zh: 即使不存在提示注入，自然语言检索也可能提高用户汇总既有授权内容的效率。
text.en: Even without prompt injection, natural-language retrieval can make it easier for users to aggregate information they are already authorized to access.

text.zh: 对组织而言，关注点包括用户一次检索涉及的范围、会话内容的可见性，以及管理设置变更后已有会话数据如何处理。自然语言交互可能使原本分散在多个位置的信息更容易被汇总，因此需要建立相应的审计基线。
text.en: Organizations should consider the scope of a query, who can see the conversation, and what happens to existing conversation data after an administrative change. Natural-language interactions may make information from multiple locations easier to combine, so establish an appropriate audit baseline.

text.zh: 域范围委派（DWD）可能授予应用访问 Workspace 数据的能力，其授权记录位于 Admin console，与 Google Cloud IAM 的视图分开。若此类身份被用于检索或分析集成，审计时应同时核对 DWD scope、应用凭据、数据源和下游服务。
text.en: Domain-wide delegation (DWD) can grant applications access to Workspace data. Its authorization records are in the Admin console and are separate from Google Cloud IAM. If such an identity is used by a search or analytics integration, review the DWD scopes, application credentials, data sources, and downstream services together.

text.zh: Gemini Enterprise 的 agent 和连接器可能以不同身份访问数据，具体行为由产品类型和配置决定。权限感知并不能替代对高权限账号、连接所有者、数据源范围及操作授权的审查。
text.en: Gemini Enterprise agents and connectors may access data through different identities, depending on product and configuration. Permission awareness does not replace review of privileged users, connector owners, data-source scope, and operation permissions.

text.zh: AI 检索改变了内容访问的交互方式，但不会让传统权限、审计和 DLP 控制失去作用。应结合产品可提供的事件字段，评估检索范围、主体和会话上下文，并确认异常访问调查所需的数据能够保留。
text.en: AI retrieval changes the interaction model for reading content, but does not make traditional permissions, audit, or DLP controls irrelevant. Review the subject, query scope, and conversation context using available product events, and confirm that required investigation data is retained.

text.zh: 六、安全风险 D：Workspace 管理控制面
text.en: 6. Security risk D: the Workspace administration plane

text.zh: API 控制表是 Workspace 应用访问治理的一部分，需与云侧 IAM 分开审查。
text.en: API controls are part of Workspace application-access governance and should be reviewed separately from cloud IAM.

text.zh: 第一，Google 自有应用可能采用与第三方应用不同的默认信任设置；管理员应按当前控制台状态核对 Gemini 相关应用的访问范围。
text.en: First, Google-owned applications may have different default trust settings from third-party applications. Administrators should verify Gemini-related access in the current console.

text.zh: 第二，API 控制与 Context-Aware Access（CAA）可能共同影响应用访问。审查设备和上下文策略时，应同时核对应用豁免与服务范围。
text.en: Second, API controls and Context-Aware Access (CAA) can jointly affect application access. Review application exemptions and service scope when assessing device and context policies.

text.zh: 第三，能够修改 API controls 或 AI 管理设置的管理员属于高价值管理主体。应限制相关角色的分配，启用适当的会话保护，并审计配置变化。Cloud IAM 无法替代 Workspace 管理面的审查。
text.en: Third, administrators who can change API controls or AI settings are high-impact identities. Limit assignment of the relevant roles, protect privileged sessions, and audit configuration changes. Cloud IAM is not a substitute for reviewing Workspace administration.

text.zh: 七、防守侧清单
text.en: 7. Governance checklist

text.zh: 治理检查可按以下方面开展：
text.en: The following checks help organize governance:

items.zh: 裁决面收紧：API controls 里把默认 Trusted 的谷歌系应用逐个过一遍，Trusted 只留给确认需要的；受限服务上给 Google 应用做显式裁决而不是吃默认值。
items.en: Review API controls and explicitly approve the Google applications that need access to restricted services.

items.zh: DWD 治理：全量列出已授权的 client ID 与 scope，最小化并定期复核；任何新增 DWD 都按域级权限变更审批。
items.en: Inventory all DWD client IDs and scopes, minimize them, and require approval for new domain-wide grants.

items.zh: 记忆与自定义指令：纳入周期性审查与清理策略，离职与调岗流程包含记忆清理。
items.en: Include memory and custom instructions in periodic review and cleanup processes.

items.zh: 共享面：外部共享（链接共享、域外协作者）是注入的入口带——out-of-domain banner 是产品给的信号，共享策略才是真正的闸。
items.en: Review external sharing, out-of-domain collaborators, and the relevant sharing policies.

items.zh: 检索模式审计：为 AI 检索行为建立“谁在问、问的范围、会话上下文”的日志口径；异常的大范围检索比异常的导出更值得告警。
items.en: Define an audit baseline for AI retrieval, including available information about the user, scope, and conversation context.

items.zh: CAA 与 API 控制联动：收紧 CAA 时同步检查 API 侧的豁免名单，别让留门的手悄悄开着。
items.en: Review API exemptions alongside CAA changes.

items.zh: 管理面自身：超管与 Service Settings 管理员的会话保护（强制强 2SV 形态、上下文限制）与 Admin console 变更审计，是以上一切的地基。
items.en: Protect Super Admin and Service Settings administrator sessions and audit Admin console changes.

items.zh: 向用户说明组织账号与个人账号的管理差异、会话数据处理方式，以及如何报告异常的 AI 访问或输出。
items.en: Explain the differences between work and personal accounts, how conversation data is handled, and how to report unexpected AI access or output.

text.zh: 要点
text.en: Key points

items.zh: Gemini 三张面孔：App 连接应用、Workspace 内嵌侧栏、Enterprise（连接器 + agent）；治理统一在 Admin console 的 AI control center。
items.en: Gemini has several product forms: connected apps, Workspace-integrated features, and Gemini Enterprise connectors and agents. Workspace administration governs important settings.

items.zh: 它不是新权限主体，而是用户权限的放大器与归纳器：把“有权看但看不完”的语料变成“一段提示就能取回”的检索面。
items.en: Gemini generally uses user or connector access; it can make existing authorized content easier to retrieve and summarize.

items.zh: 工作身份下开关在管理员；个人身份下没有这道闸——同一个产品，两种边界。
items.en: Workspace administrators control connected-app settings for work or school accounts; personal accounts have different controls.

items.zh: 会话有快照效应：事后关闸，已流入会话的内容继续可用。
items.en: Disabling an application does not necessarily remove data already present in an existing conversation.

items.zh: 官方“不能做”清单反着读就是可达面索引：文本、文档、日历、任务是天然入口。
items.en: Product capabilities and restrictions vary by service and should be checked against current documentation.

items.zh: 隐私承诺三件套：不用于训练（CDPA 约束）、会话隔离（仅本人可见）、外部共享有 banner——但会话隔离不覆盖记忆。
items.en: Privacy considerations include model training, conversation visibility, and external sharing; cross-session memory is a separate setting to review.

items.zh: 间接提示注入是检索式 AI 的输入风险；GeminiJack 是已公开披露并已修复的历史案例，不代表当前可利用性。
items.en: Indirect prompt injection is an input risk for retrieval-based AI. GeminiJack is a publicly disclosed and patched historical case, not evidence of current exploitability.

items.zh: 跨会话记忆与自定义指令应纳入独立的数据生命周期和审计流程。
items.en: Cross-session memory and custom instructions need their own lifecycle and audit controls.

items.zh: 检索与连接器可能提高既有授权内容的汇总效率；审查范围应覆盖用户、应用身份、DWD scope 和数据源。
items.en: Retrieval and connectors can increase the efficiency of aggregating already-authorized content; review users, application identities, DWD scopes, and data sources.

items.zh: Workspace API controls 与云侧 IAM 是不同的管理面，相关管理员和配置变更都应纳入审计。
items.en: Workspace API controls and Google Cloud IAM are separate management planes; audit their administrators and configuration changes.

items.zh: AI 检索审计应结合主体、范围和会话上下文，并按产品实际提供的日志字段评估。
items.en: AI retrieval audits should consider the user, scope, and conversation context available in the product logs.

title.zh: Google Workspace 身份管理与 Apple 联邦
title.en: Google Workspace Identity Management and Apple Federation

summary.zh: 本文梳理 Workspace 的域名与目录边界、组织单元、管理员角色、两步验证和联邦登录，并讨论 API 控制、域范围委派、冲突账户，以及 Workspace 与 Apple Business Manager 的联邦关系。
summary.en: This article reviews Workspace domain and directory boundaries, organizational units, administrator roles, 2-Step Verification, federation, API controls, domain-wide delegation, unmanaged accounts, and federation with Apple Business Manager.

text.zh: Workspace（连同 Cloud Identity）在 Google 体系中最接近租户边界：它有域名、目录和管理控制台，也与自己的计费关系相连。其管理模型、与 Google Cloud 的授权关系，以及对外联邦方式都不同于 Entra。本文聚焦 Workspace 的认证与管理面，以及它与 Apple Business Manager 的联邦关系。
text.en: Workspace, together with Cloud Identity, is the closest equivalent to a tenant boundary in Google's ecosystem: it has a domain, directory, and administration console, and is linked to its own billing arrangements. Its administrative model, authorization relationship with Google Cloud, and external federation options differ from Microsoft Entra. This article focuses on Workspace authentication and administration, and its federation with Apple Business Manager.

text.zh: 一、域名是身份根
text.en: 1. The domain is the identity anchor

text.zh: Workspace 的骨架是一条主域名加一个目录。Directory API 的 customer ID 就是这个目录的编号——云侧组织节点的 owner 字段填的正是它，且不可更改。“租户”在谷歌体系里不是一个独立的云对象，而是邮箱侧目录在云侧的投影。
text.en: Workspace is built around a primary domain and a directory. The Directory API customer ID identifies that directory; the corresponding Google Cloud organization records this ID as its owner, and it cannot be changed. The term "tenant" does not refer to a standalone Google Cloud object: the directory on the email side is reflected in the cloud hierarchy.

text.zh: 层级上，Workspace 提供两类入口：付费的 Google Workspace 各版本，和免费的 Cloud Identity。Cloud Identity 是纯身份与设备管理服务，Workspace 在其上叠加生产力套件。对企业边界来说两者等价：都是受管账号的世界，都能挂组织节点，都归 Admin console 管。
text.en: Workspace offers two service families: paid Google Workspace editions and the free Cloud Identity service. Cloud Identity provides identity and device management; Workspace adds productivity services. For enterprise boundaries, both provide managed accounts, an organization node, and the Admin console.

text.zh: 管理单元是组织单元（OU）：用户和设备按 OU 分层，服务开关与策略按 OU 生效。云侧 IAM 没有 OU 的对应物——OU 属于邮箱侧的裁决体系，云侧的资源策略只认资源层级。同一个员工，在邮箱侧属于某个 OU（受一套策略管），在云侧属于某个项目/组织的 IAM 主体集合（受另一套策略管），两个“位置”互不镜像。
text.en: Organizational units (OUs) are Workspace's administrative units. Users and devices can be arranged in an OU hierarchy, and service settings and policies can be applied by OU. Google Cloud IAM has no equivalent OU hierarchy: OUs belong to Workspace administration, while cloud resource policies follow the Google Cloud resource hierarchy. A person can therefore have one administrative context in Workspace and a different IAM context in Google Cloud.

text.zh: Workspace 的管理员权限体系是预定义管理员角色，按功能域拆分，角色可以按 OU 收窄作用范围。这套体系与云侧 IAM 完全独立：Workspace 管理员角色在 Admin console 里看，云侧角色在 IAM 里看，名字相似，归属不同。
text.en: Workspace uses predefined administrator roles, which can be scoped to OUs. This role system is separate from Google Cloud IAM: Workspace roles are reviewed in the Admin console, while cloud roles are reviewed in IAM. Similar role names do not imply shared authorization.

text.zh: 二、超级管理员：信任根是一条人
text.en: 2. Super administrators and recovery

text.zh: Super Admin 位于管理员体系的顶端，掌握四类关键能力。
text.en: The Super Admin role is at the top of Workspace administration and has several important capabilities.

text.zh: 第一，管理员世界的门钥匙：分配管理员角色、对管理员账号重置密码，只有超管能做——其他管理员角色不能重置管理员密码。
text.en: First, it controls administrator assignments and can reset administrator passwords; other administrator roles cannot reset administrator passwords.

text.zh: 第二，恢复路径：域内至少需要一名超管，建议两名互为恢复；谷歌的恢复流程支持预先指定恢复用的辅助邮箱，而这个邮箱在域外——一个域外的强信任点。
text.en: Second, the organization needs a recovery path. Google recommends having at least one Super Admin and planning for recovery. The recovery process can use a preconfigured secondary email address, which may be outside the managed domain and should be treated as a trusted recovery channel.

text.zh: 第三，域名所有权的保人：超管是域名验证的责任人和找回联系人，因此默认拥有分配 IAM 角色的能力，其在云侧的主要动作是把 Organization Administrator 授予域内合适的人。
text.en: Third, a Super Admin is involved in domain ownership verification and recovery. In Google Cloud, the role is associated with the ability to grant IAM roles; its primary cloud-side responsibility is often to grant Organization Administrator to appropriate people in the domain.

text.zh: 第四，通知的终点：至少一名超管被指定为 primary administrator，接收账单与谷歌发出的关键通知。
text.en: Fourth, at least one Super Admin can be designated as the primary administrator for important billing and Google notifications.

text.zh: 把四类能力合起来：谷歌体系的信任根不是一把钥匙，而是一条人。超管同时是域名找回、管理员恢复、云侧授权的交汇点。任何能到达“重置管理员密码”的路径——恢复流程、域外辅助邮箱、超管的会话与令牌——都直接暴露整个体系的根。
text.en: Together, these responsibilities make the Super Admin role a high-impact identity. Domain recovery, administrator recovery, and cloud-side authorization may converge on this role. Recovery methods and privileged sessions therefore deserve the same protection and monitoring as the primary administrator account.

text.zh: 三、用户认证路径：2SV、联邦与上下文
text.en: 3. User authentication: 2-Step Verification, federation, and context

text.zh: 普通用户的认证是密码加第二因子。管理员可以把 2SV 从用户自选推进到强制全员，并按 OU 和分组例外。第二因子的形态从短信、验证码到安全密钥不等，抗钓鱼能力差别很大：短信与电话验证码抗不掉 SIM 换卡，安全密钥才抗。管理员策略决定了整个域的认证下限。
text.en: For ordinary users, authentication commonly combines a password with a second factor. Administrators can move 2-Step Verification (2SV) from optional to required and can configure exceptions by OU or group. Second-factor methods range from SMS and one-time codes to security keys; their phishing resistance varies, and security keys provide stronger phishing resistance than SMS or voice codes. The administrator policy sets the authentication baseline for the domain.

text.zh: 第二层是联邦。Workspace 支持把第三方 IdP 放在登录路径上（SAML/OIDC），让企业已有目录成为谷歌账号的认证源；同时谷歌自己也对外做 IdP（苹果线是最大客户）。方向不同，信任模型相同：密码学的根从一个域搬到另一个域，会话的根始终在谷歌侧。联邦配置的两个固定检查点：退出联邦时锁死了谁；超管是否被联邦策略覆盖（必须保留不联邦的后门管理员，否则 IdP 故障等于全员锁死）。
text.en: Workspace can also federate sign-in to a third-party identity provider through SAML or OIDC. An organization may use its existing identity system as the authentication source for Google accounts. Google can also act as an identity provider for other services, including the Apple integration discussed later. The direction differs, but each arrangement depends on a configured trust relationship. When changing federation, identify users who might lose access and ensure that recovery administrators are not unintentionally locked behind the same federation dependency.

text.zh: 第三层是上下文裁决：Workspace 的 Context-Aware Access（CAA）按设备、位置、IP 等条件给服务访问划线。关键细节在 API 控制侧：管理员可以给 OAuth 应用配置“豁免被 CAA 阻断的 API 访问”，但豁免不是单向开关——还要在 CAA 级别分配里同步豁免才生效。设备信任信号、认证强度、上下文条件共同构成邮箱侧的访问决策；它的裁决对象不只是浏览器会话，还包括 API 访问。
text.en: Context-Aware Access (CAA) applies conditions such as device state, location, or IP address to service access. For API access, an administrator can configure OAuth applications to be exempt from CAA blocking; the exemption also needs to be reflected in the relevant CAA assignment. Device trust, authentication strength, and context conditions jointly shape Workspace access decisions for both browser and API sessions.

text.zh: 四、API 控制面：Work 高于 Cloud 的裁决点
text.en: 4. API controls: Workspace's application access boundary

text.zh: Admin console 的 Security → Access and data control → API controls 是一张裁决表，对象是“应用”，粒度是 OAuth client ID（包括服务账号的 client ID）。裁决分四档：
text.en: Admin console's **Security → Access and data control → API controls** is an application access policy keyed by OAuth client ID, including client IDs for service accounts. The policy offers four levels:

items.zh: Trusted：应用可以访问全部 Google Workspace 服务（OAuth scopes），包括受限服务。
items.en: **Specific Google data**: the application can request only the scopes configured for it.

items.zh: Specific Google data：只能请求配置时指定的 scope。
items.en: **Trusted**: the application can access all Google Workspace services, including restricted services.

items.zh: Limited：只能访问不受限服务。
items.en: **Limited**: the application can access only unrestricted services.

items.zh: Blocked：不能访问任何 Google 数据。
items.en: **Blocked**: the application cannot access Google data.

text.zh: 三条结构性规则决定这张表的分量。
text.en: Three structural rules affect how this policy should be reviewed.

text.zh: 第一，谷歌自家应用默认站在高信任一侧：非 Workspace 类的 Google-owned 应用默认大多是 Trusted——云侧的服务账号再怎么折腾 OAuth，到了邮箱侧，默认裁决表里谷歌系应用是畅通的。
text.en: First, some Google-owned applications may receive a different default trust treatment from third-party applications. Review the current console setting for each application rather than assuming a universal default.

text.zh: 第二，Blocked 压倒设备 allowlist：设备面和 API 面冲突时，API 面赢。
text.en: Second, Blocked can override an allowlist configured for devices: where API and device policies conflict, the API control can determine access.

text.zh: 第三，Trusted 应用可以在 CAA 收紧时维持 API 访问：把配置了 OAuth client ID 的应用加入 allowlist，即使相关服务部署了 CAA 策略作用于 API 访问，该应用仍保留 API 通路。
text.en: Third, an application marked Trusted may retain API access when CAA is tightened, depending on the service and policy configuration. Review API controls and CAA together.

text.zh: 把三条放回多 BU 的坐标系，得到“Work 高于 Cloud”的精确含义：云侧 IAM 完全管不到邮箱数据，而邮箱侧的一张表就能裁决云侧身份（服务账号、第三方 OAuth 应用）能不能碰 Workspace。Cloud 给不出任何邮箱授权，Work 却能让云侧身份全有或全无——两棵树的权重不对称。评估一个“云侧权限不大”的服务账号时，必须跨到 Admin console 查它的 client ID 被裁成了什么。
text.en: These rules illustrate an important boundary: Google Cloud IAM does not grant access to Workspace mailbox data, while Workspace API controls can determine whether a cloud-side service account or third-party OAuth application may access Workspace services. For a cloud identity that appears to have limited IAM permissions, also review how its client ID is classified in the Admin console.

text.zh: “Work 高于 Cloud”描述的是授权边界：云侧 IAM 不授予邮箱数据访问权，而 Workspace API 控制策略可以限制云侧身份访问 Workspace 数据。云团队和 Workspace 团队应交叉审查 Admin console 与 IAM 中的相关配置。
text.en: "Workspace over Cloud" describes an authorization boundary, not a universal hierarchy. Cloud IAM cannot grant mailbox access, while Workspace's API controls can govern Google Cloud identities that request Workspace data. Security teams should review both systems rather than assume that either console presents the complete picture.

text.zh: 五、域范围委派：一枚服务账号的域级跃迁
text.en: 5. Domain-wide delegation and application access

text.zh: 域范围委派（domain-wide delegation，DWD）是邮箱侧最大的授予面。它允许超级管理员授予客户端应用访问全体 Workspace 用户数据的权限，且该授权不要求用户同意。
text.en: Domain-wide delegation (DWD) allows a Super Admin to grant a client application access to data across Workspace users without requiring each user to consent.

text.zh: 机制三步：必须由超级管理员操作；拿到应用的 client ID（服务账号的 client ID，或第三方 OAuth 应用的 client ID）；在 Manage Domain Wide Delegation 里把 client ID 与一串 OAuth scope 绑定到域。生效之后，该应用可以访问域内全体用户的数据。
text.en: The configuration associates an application client ID—such as a service account or third-party OAuth application—with a set of OAuth scopes in **Manage Domain Wide Delegation**. Once authorized, the application may access data covered by those scopes.

text.zh: 在云侧，这只是一个普通服务账号——IAM 绑定可能小到只有跑任务的权限，日志里它只是它自己。在邮箱侧，它是一张覆盖全目录的通行证，授权记录不在云侧 IAM 里，在 Admin console 的 DWD 表里。两侧的审计视图没有任何一处同时显示“这个 client ID 的云侧角色 + 邮箱侧 scope”——授予是跨体系的，审计是分体系的。
text.en: The cloud and Workspace views are separate. In Google Cloud, the identity may be an ordinary service account with narrow IAM bindings; in Workspace, its client ID may have broad scopes recorded in the Admin console's DWD configuration. No single view necessarily shows both the cloud roles and Workspace scopes.

text.zh: DWD 的审查重点在授权范围：持有有效凭据且获 DWD 授权的服务账号，其 Workspace 数据访问能力取决于 Admin console 中配置的 scope，而不只取决于云侧角色。应限制 scope、管理服务账号生命周期，并将 DWD 配置变更纳入域级审批。
text.en: DWD should be governed as a domain-level grant. Review each client ID and scope, keep scopes narrow, remove grants that are no longer needed, and require approval and audit for changes. A service account's cloud IAM role does not describe its Workspace access.

text.zh: 六、冲突账户与影子身份
text.en: 6. Conflicting and unmanaged accounts

text.zh: 同一个邮箱地址，个人世界里是未受管账号，企业世界里是受管账号，登录框完全一样。两个账号不能共享同一个用户名；潜在冲突应在用户加入 Cloud Identity 之前审查并解决。
text.en: The same email address may identify an unmanaged personal account and a separate managed Workspace account. The sign-in screens can look similar, but the accounts are distinct. Potential account conflicts should be reviewed and resolved before adding the user to Cloud Identity.

text.zh: 冲突账户会带来几类治理风险。用户可能混淆个人与受管身份；未受管账号创建的项目可能不在组织目录和云资源审计范围内；即使受管身份停用，个人账号及其登录记录、OAuth 授权和订阅关系仍可能存在。应通过账号发现、归属确认和数据迁移流程处理这些边界。
text.en: Unmanaged accounts complicate asset ownership and lifecycle management. Projects created under unmanaged accounts may sit outside the organization's resource hierarchy; OAuth grants and subscriptions may also remain associated with the unmanaged identity after a managed account is disabled. Inventory and offboarding procedures should account for both identities and their associated resources.

text.zh: 七、苹果联邦线：谷歌做企业的 IdP，苹果认设备
text.en: 7. Apple federation: Workspace identity and device ownership

text.zh: 苹果的 Apple Business Manager（ABM）支持与 Google Workspace 的联邦认证：管理员在 ABM 里选择“Sign in with Google”，用 Workspace 管理员身份完成配置，之后 Managed Apple ID 的认证走谷歌凭据。方向明确：设备世界的用户身份，由 Workspace 域发牌。
text.en: Apple Business Manager (ABM) supports federated authentication with Google Workspace. An administrator selects **Sign in with Google** in ABM and configures the Workspace administrator identity; Managed Apple ID authentication then uses Google credentials.

text.zh: 谷歌侧的对应能力是公司自有 iOS 设备管理：管理员可以在 Google Admin console 里管理公司所有的 iPhone 和 iPad，前提是把 Apple Business Manager 或 Apple School Manager 与 Workspace 或 Cloud Identity 订阅关联。这条集成 2020 年上线（当时 ABM 还叫 Device Enrollment Program），让 iOS 设备管理出现在 Admin console 的统一设备视图里。
text.en: Google also supports management of organization-owned iOS devices through the Admin console, provided Apple Business Manager or Apple School Manager is linked to a Workspace or Cloud Identity subscription. The integration launched in 2020, when ABM was still known as the Device Enrollment Program, and brought iOS device management into Google's device view.

text.zh: 这条联邦线的信任结构分三段：Workspace 认证人（联邦 IdP 是谷歌），ABM/ASM 认证设备的归属（设备进不进企业的注册池，是苹果侧的裁决），MDM 回填设备合规信号。三个平面各管一段：谁是人、设备是谁的、设备可不可信。
text.en: This federation spans three control planes: Workspace authenticates the person, ABM determines whether a device belongs to the organization, and mobile device management reports device state. These systems govern different facts—who the user is, whether the device is organization-owned, and whether it meets policy.

text.zh: 三个平面的策略需分别治理。Workspace 用户状态变化会影响 Managed Apple ID 登录；设备注册池由 ABM 配置；MDM 再将设备管理状态反馈给组织。应分别审查身份停用流程、ABM 管理权限和设备合规策略，并确认联邦登录的审计记录覆盖各环节。
text.en: The three planes should be reviewed independently and together. Changes to a Workspace account can affect Managed Apple ID sign-in; device enrollment and ownership remain governed by ABM; device compliance is reported through MDM. Confirm administrative ownership and recovery paths for each system.

text.zh: 关键边界
text.en: Key points

items.zh: Workspace/Cloud Identity 是谷歌体系里最像租户的对象：域名是身份根，customer ID 是云侧组织的 owner。
items.en: Workspace and Cloud Identity provide the closest Google equivalent to a tenant boundary; the domain anchors identity, and the Directory customer ID is recorded by the cloud organization.

items.zh: OU 是邮箱侧管理单元，与云侧资源层级互不镜像；两根柱子中间只有少数横线。
items.en: OUs are Workspace administrative units and do not mirror Google Cloud resource folders.

items.zh: 信任根是一条人：超管独占管理员分配与管理员密码重置，同时是域名找回联系人与云侧 IAM 授予能力的持有者。
items.en: Super Admin accounts control administrator assignments and recovery paths and can grant cloud IAM roles.

items.zh: 2SV 形态决定全域认证下限；联邦方向不同但会话根始终在谷歌侧；超管必须保留不联邦的恢复路径。
items.en: 2SV methods vary in phishing resistance; federation and recovery paths should be reviewed together.

items.zh: API 控制四档：Trusted/Specific Google data/Limited/Blocked，粒度是 OAuth client ID（含服务账号）。
items.en: API controls classify applications by OAuth client ID, including service accounts.

items.zh: 谷歌自家应用默认 Trusted；Blocked 压倒设备 allowlist；Trusted 应用可在 CAA 收紧时维持 API 访问。
items.en: Google-owned applications may have different defaults; Blocked, CAA, and allowlist behavior must be checked against current settings.

items.zh: “Work 高于 Cloud”是裁决拓扑：Cloud 给不出邮箱授权，Work 一张表裁决云侧身份的全有或全无。
items.en: Workspace API controls and Google Cloud IAM are separate authorization systems.

items.zh: DWD：超管把 client ID + scopes 绑到域，应用不经用户同意访问全体用户数据——跨体系授予、分体系审计。
items.en: DWD associates client IDs with scopes and can grant broad Workspace data access without per-user consent.

items.zh: 一枚被 DWD 授权的服务账号是域级身份，其价值由 Admin console 的 scope 决定，与云侧角色无关。
items.en: A service account's Workspace access is determined by its DWD scopes, not solely by its Google Cloud roles.

items.zh: 冲突账户：同一邮箱可能对应个人与受管身份；未受管账号及其项目需要纳入资产发现和数据治理。
items.en: Unmanaged accounts can own projects, OAuth grants, or subscriptions outside the managed directory.

items.zh: 苹果线三平面：Workspace 负责身份认证，ABM 管理设备归属，MDM 提供设备合规状态；三者的策略与审计应保持一致。
items.en: Apple federation spans Workspace authentication, ABM device ownership, and MDM compliance.
