title.zh: Google Cloud 身份、资源层级与计费
title.en: Google Cloud Identity, Resource Hierarchy, and Billing

summary.zh: 本文梳理消费者账号、Workspace/Cloud Identity 受管账号与 Google Cloud 资源之间的关系，重点讨论 organization、folder、project 层级、服务账号凭据，以及 Cloud Billing 与 Google payments 的计费结构。
summary.en: This article reviews consumer and managed identities, the Google Cloud organization-folder-project hierarchy, service-account credentials, and the relationship between Cloud Billing accounts and Google payments.

text.zh: Google Cloud 的结构与 Microsoft 的三棵边界树（身份租户、资源订阅、计费账户）可以对应，但每一层的名称、归属与授权方向都不同。评估谷歌体系的第一步不是打开控制台，而是承认其多业务单元的事实：消费者侧的 Google 账号、Workspace（含 Cloud Identity）的域账号、Google Cloud 的项目与组织，是三条商务线；它们共享同一套账号协议，而边界由三件事决定——谁认证你、你的令牌能进哪个产品域、你的消费记在谁的账上。
text.en: Google Cloud's structure can be compared with Microsoft's identity-tenant, resource-subscription, and billing-account boundaries, but the names, ownership, and authorization paths differ. Google's ecosystem includes consumer Google accounts, Workspace or Cloud Identity accounts, and Google Cloud projects and organizations. They share some account protocols, but identity, product access, and billing remain distinct.

text.zh: 多 BU 的边界在结算侧最直白：Cloud Billing account 统计 Google Cloud、Google Maps Platform、Firebase 和 Google AI Studio 的用量，按产品线记账而非按客户记账；而 Google payments profile 连接整个 Google 家族——Ads、Cloud、Workspace、Fi 共用同一份付款资料，云管理员在 IAM 里看不见它。工程侧同样是这个投影：谷歌按产品域分别暴露 MCP 端点（BigQuery、Cloud Storage、Compute Engine、Cloud Billing、Resource Manager、IAM），端点独立、工具集独立，认证共用同一个 OAuth 2.0 Bearer token。token 统一、授权面分立，这就是“部门”在技术上的形态。
text.en: The separation is visible in both billing and engineering. Cloud Billing accounts record usage for eligible Google Cloud products, while Google payments profiles belong to Google's broader payments system and are separate from Cloud IAM. Google Cloud also exposes product-specific MCP endpoints and tools; a shared identity system does not imply shared authorization. Product coverage and billing relationships can vary by service and account configuration, so verify the current documentation.

text.zh: 一、资源树：organization、folder、project
text.en: 1. The resource hierarchy

text.zh: 资源层级的定义：除最高层外，每个资源恰好有一个父节点；层级由 organization（根）、folder（可选，分组用）、project（实际资源的容器）三层组成，Compute Engine 虚拟机、存储桶、数据集等服务资源挂在项目之下。
text.en: Except for the top-level resource, each resource has exactly one parent. The hierarchy consists of an organization at the root, optional folders for grouping, and projects that contain service resources such as Compute Engine virtual machines, storage buckets, datasets, and keys.

text.zh:
organization（根，锚定 Workspace/Cloud Identity 域）
└── folder（可选，分组用）
    └── project（实际资源的容器）
        └── 服务资源：VM、bucket、数据集、密钥……
text.en:
organization（根，锚定 Workspace/Cloud Identity 域）
└── folder（可选，分组用）
    └── project（实际资源的容器）
        └── 服务资源：VM、bucket、数据集、密钥……

text.zh: 三个要点。
text.en: Three properties matter.

text.zh: 第一，单亲规则。除根之外每个资源恰好一个父节点，没有“一个项目挂多个组织”或“一个 folder 跨组织”的设计；任何跨边界的访问都是 IAM 授权的叠加，不是层级结构的合并。树内是继承，树外是显式授权——显式授权可审计，也应是侦察重点。
text.en: First, the hierarchy is single-parent. A project cannot belong to multiple organizations, and a folder cannot span organizations. Access across hierarchy boundaries comes from IAM grants rather than combining resource trees. Policies are inherited within the tree; cross-boundary access should be reviewed as an explicit grant.

text.zh: 第二，组织节点不是云侧创建的。它跟随 Google Workspace 或 Cloud Identity 账户存在，且一个账户只能关联一个 organization。组织节点有四个属性：组织 ID、由 Workspace 主域名生成的显示名、创建时间、作为 owner 的 Directory API customer ID（不可变更）。域名层面的归属决定云层面的归属上限。
text.en: Second, the organization node is associated with a Workspace or Cloud Identity account rather than created independently as an ordinary cloud resource. An account can be associated with one organization. The organization has an ID, a display name derived from the primary Workspace domain, a creation time, and an immutable Directory API customer ID as its owner. Domain ownership therefore anchors the cloud organization.

text.zh: 第三，初始授权需要复核。organization 创建时，默认 allow policy 可将 Project Creator 与 Billing Account Creator 角色授予 Workspace 域；组织管理员应核对是否符合本组织的最小权限要求。受管用户创建的项目通常归入 organization，既有项目的父资源与所有权则应单独确认。无父节点的项目可能来自个人、未受管账号或历史配置，也可能迁入 organization。项目通常由组织而非创建它的员工持有；组织删除会影响其下资源，因此需为项目生命周期安排明确的转移和归档流程。
text.en: Third, initial access needs review. When an organization is created, its default allow policy can grant Project Creator and Billing Account Creator to the Workspace domain. Administrators should confirm that this matches the organization's least-privilege requirements. Projects created by managed users generally belong to the organization; the parent and ownership of existing projects should be checked separately. Projects without an organization parent may come from consumer or unmanaged accounts, or from legacy configurations, and may be migrated. Projects are generally owned by the organization rather than the employee who created them. Deleting an organization affects its resources, so project transfer and archival need an explicit lifecycle plan.

text.zh: 层级之上有三条独立的继承链：allow、deny、organization policy。每个资源的最终策略是“直接作用于该资源的策略”与“从祖先继承的策略”的合成，deny 可以凌驾 allow 之上。评估某资源最终允许什么时，三条链都要算完；只看 IAM 面板会漏掉 deny 与组织策略的约束。
text.en: Three policy mechanisms participate in the hierarchy: allow policies, deny policies, and organization policies. A resource's effective policy combines direct assignments with inherited ancestor policies; a deny policy can override an allow. An IAM-only review may miss deny or organization-policy constraints.

text.zh: 我会将没有组织父节点的项目列入资产核对：确认其所有者、计费方式、数据位置和迁移状态。它们可能来自个人或未受管账号，也可能是历史遗留项目；应逐项确认，而不要仅凭是否挂在组织下推断其来源或风险。
text.en: I include projects without an organization parent in asset reconciliation and confirm their owner, billing arrangement, data location, and migration status. Such projects may belong to consumer or unmanaged accounts, or may be legacy assets; their origin and risk should be established rather than inferred from hierarchy alone.

text.zh: 二、身份树：谷歌没有“租户”对象
text.en: 2. Identity accounts and principals

text.zh: 微软体系最清晰的锚是 Entra 租户；谷歌没有对应物。最接近的结构是“Workspace/Cloud Identity 账户 + organization 节点”的组合，而这两者分别住在邮箱侧和云侧。谷歌的“身份树”要按账号类型读，而不是按容器读。
text.en: Microsoft Entra has a clearly defined tenant object; Google has no direct equivalent. The closest analogue is the combination of a Workspace or Cloud Identity account and its organization node, which sit on the productivity and cloud sides respectively. Google's identity model is best understood by account type rather than by a single tenant container.

text.zh: 三类账号。第一类是消费者账号：@gmail.com 结尾，没有任何管理方，只能进入免费层资源，或作为 IAM principal 被显式授权。第二类是受管账号：Workspace 或 Cloud Identity 域下的用户，有 Admin console、有组织节点、有目录。第三类是未受管账号（unmanaged account）：用户先用工作邮箱地址注册了个人账号或未受管的工作账号，之后公司再建立同名受管账号——同一个邮箱地址背后站着两个账号体系。
text.en: There are three broad account types. Consumer accounts, often ending in `@gmail.com`, have no organizational administrator and can access free-tier resources or be granted access as explicit IAM principals. Managed accounts belong to a Workspace or Cloud Identity domain and are administered through the Admin console. An unmanaged account can arise when a person registers a work email address for a personal or unmanaged account before the organization creates a managed account using the same address; the two accounts are separate even though the sign-in identifier looks identical.

text.zh: 冲突规则直接由此而来：两个账号不能共享同一个用户名；向 Cloud Identity 添加用户之前，应先审查并解决潜在的冲突账户。登录框完全相同，账户体系截然不同。这既是社工钓鱼的天然土壤，也解释了“一个邮箱的项目权限与邮箱权限对不上”这类现场怪象。
text.en: The conflict arises because two accounts cannot share the same username. Potential conflicts should be reviewed before adding a user to Cloud Identity. Similar sign-in screens do not indicate the same account, which can also explain why a project's access history does not match the managed mailbox identity.

text.zh: 放进 IAM 视角，principal 的类型包括 user、serviceAccount、group、domain，以及联邦体系下的 principalSet。值得注意的是 domain 这种 principal——组织初始授权正是把 Project Creator 和 Billing Account Creator 授予了整个域。“这个域”本身就是一个可以被授予权限的主体；任何 domain principal 的绑定都值得单独立账，因为它的影响面是全目录。
text.en: IAM principals include users, service accounts, groups, domains, and principal sets used by federation. A domain is itself a principal: organization defaults can grant roles to an entire domain. Domain-wide grants should therefore be reviewed as directory-scale authorization.

text.zh: 三、服务凭证：三种形态与一条链
text.en: 3. Service credentials: short-lived tokens and keys

text.zh: 服务账号和用户一样可以获取 OAuth 2.0 访问令牌调用 Google API，但路径不同。凭证分两大类：短时凭据与密钥。
text.en: Like users, service accounts can obtain OAuth 2.0 access tokens for Google APIs, but their credential paths differ. The main distinction is between short-lived credentials and keys.

text.zh: 短时凭据是推荐路径，默认访问令牌一小时过期。获取方式大多自动完成：`gcloud --impersonate-service-account` 生成短时凭据并以该身份执行命令；挂在 Compute Engine 实例上的服务账号由客户端库通过应用默认凭据（ADC）取得短时凭据；工作负载身份联邦让客户端库用外部 IdP 的凭据换取短时凭据。Service Account Credentials API 也可手动签发三类凭证：OAuth 2.0 访问令牌、OIDC ID 令牌、自签 JWT。
text.en: Short-lived credentials are generally preferred; access tokens commonly expire after one hour. They may be obtained through service-account impersonation with `gcloud --impersonate-service-account`, through Application Default Credentials (ADC) for a service account attached to a Compute Engine instance, or through Workload Identity Federation (WIF) using an external identity provider. The Service Account Credentials API can also issue OAuth 2.0 access tokens, OIDC ID tokens, and self-signed JWTs.

text.zh: 密钥是另一极。服务账号密钥是长期凭证；持有密钥的任何一方都能以该服务账号身份签发 JWT 并换取访问令牌。密钥文件本身不绑定任何主机、进程或人——这正是它与短时凭据的本质差别：短时凭据有签发链路可审计（多数服务会记录“谁模拟了谁”），密钥文件的使用在日志里只表现为服务账号自己。
text.en: Service-account keys are long-lived credentials. Anyone holding a key can act as the service account by signing a JWT and exchanging it for an access token. A key file is not bound to a particular host, process, or person. Short-lived credential issuance usually provides a clearer audit trail, while use of a service-account key may appear only as the service account itself.

text.zh: 工作负载身份联邦是密钥的替代路径，适用面包括：X.509 客户端证书、AWS 或 Azure 上的工作负载、本地 Active Directory、GitHub/GitLab 部署流水线，以及任何支持 OIDC 或 SAML 2.0 的 IdP。机制遵循 OAuth 2.0 token exchange 规范（RFC 8693）：外部凭据交给 Security Token Service，验证后换回联邦令牌。授权有两条路：direct access（角色直接授予联邦身份主体）和 service account impersonation（授予模拟某个服务账号的能力）。工程结构是 workload identity pool 与 pool provider；还支持把 JWKS 直接上传到 pool，服务不能暴露公网 OIDC 端点的环境（自托管 CI、企业内网平台）。
text.en: Workload Identity Federation is an alternative to long-lived keys. Supported sources include X.509 client certificates, workloads running on AWS or Azure, on-premises Active Directory, GitHub or GitLab pipelines, and identity providers that support OIDC or SAML 2.0. Under the OAuth 2.0 token exchange model (RFC 8693), an external credential is presented to Security Token Service and exchanged for a federated token. Access can be granted directly to a federated principal or through service-account impersonation. WIF uses workload identity pools and providers; providers may also use uploaded JWKS where an external public OIDC endpoint is unavailable.

text.zh: 把这些串起来的是应用默认凭据（ADC）的查找链：环境变量指定的凭据文件 → gcloud 安装的用户凭据 → 附加在计算资源上的服务账号，客户端库按此顺序查找。计算资源上的服务账号还有第四条取凭路径：元数据服务，工作负载通过内部端点取得 attached 服务账号的令牌。
text.en: Application Default Credentials (ADC) provide a lookup sequence for client libraries: a credential file specified by an environment variable, user credentials installed by gcloud, and a service account attached to a compute resource. An attached service account can also provide credentials through the metadata service.

text.zh: 评估服务凭证面时按三条链计数：文件链（SA key、ADC 顺序、gcloud 配置——谁拿到文件谁就是它）、协议链（WIF pool/provider——外部身份换云身份，信任关系是可枚举的配置）、运行时链（attached SA 与元数据服务——位置即身份）。三条链的检测信号完全不同：文件链看文件落地，协议链看 token exchange 的配置变化，运行时链看元数据端点的非常规访问。SSRF 在云上之所以是高危，正是因为它把第三条链暴露给了第一条链的攻击者——从“让服务器替我发请求”升级为“拿到当前虚拟机身份的令牌”。只盯一条，另外两条就是盲区。
text.en: I assess service-credential exposure across three paths: files (service-account keys, ADC files, and gcloud configuration), federation (WIF pools and providers), and runtime identity (attached service accounts and metadata services). Each path has different controls and audit signals. Metadata access should be restricted and monitored as part of workload isolation.

text.zh: 四、结算树：三层账户
text.en: 4. Billing: three account layers

text.zh: 谷歌的结算体系分三层，且三层分属不同世界：Cloud Billing account 是云侧资源，Google payments profile 与 payments account 是谷歌级账户体系。
text.en: Google billing has three layers with different administrative boundaries: Cloud Billing accounts are cloud resources, while Google payments accounts and payments profiles belong to Google's payments system.

text.zh: 第一层，Cloud Billing account：云控制台管理的云级资源，记账对象是所有链接到该结算账户的项目，覆盖 Google Cloud、Google Maps Platform、Firebase、Google AI Studio 的用量；单一币种结算；自助式（self-serve，在线开通、信用卡付款）账户按账户出具月度对账单，账期类（invoiced）账户按账户出具单张发票；另有子账户（subaccounts）形态，面向经销商场景。
text.en: The first layer is the Cloud Billing account. It records usage for projects linked to the account and, depending on product and account configuration, may cover Google Cloud, Google Maps Platform, Firebase, and Google AI Studio. An account uses a single currency. Self-serve accounts are opened online and may be paid by credit card; invoiced accounts have invoice-based billing. Subaccounts are available for reseller scenarios.

text.zh: 第二层，Google payments account：与 Cloud Billing account 链接并为其产生的费用付款，被分配 charging cycle（预付或后付），同时是票据中心——发票、对账单、付款历史归其管理，并控制谁可以查看与接收发票。
text.en: The second layer is the Google payments account. It is linked to a Cloud Billing account and pays the charges, with an assigned charging cycle such as prepaid or postpaid. It also manages invoices, statements, payment history, and who can view or receive billing documents.

text.zh: 第三层，Google payments profile：谷歌级资源，由 Google payments center 管理，连接全部 Google 服务，存储支付工具、国家地区、税号与责任人信息，并拥有独立于 Cloud IAM 的 payments 用户与权限体系。
text.en: The third layer is the Google payments profile. Managed through Google Payments Center, it may connect multiple Google services and store payment instruments, country or region, tax details, and responsible contacts. It has its own payments users and permissions, separate from Cloud IAM.

text.zh:
Google payments profile（谷歌级，全家桶共享）
└── Google payments account（充电周期/票据中心）
        │  被链接、代付款
        ▼
Cloud Billing account（云级资源，单一币种）
        │  记账
        ▼
project（实际产生用量的地方）
text.en:
Google payments profile（谷歌级，全家桶共享）
└── Google payments account（充电周期/票据中心）
        │  被链接、代付款
        ▼
Cloud Billing account（云级资源，单一币种）
        │  记账
        ▼
project（实际产生用量的地方）

text.zh: 结算面的授权是独立的 IAM 体系，角色分工如下：
text.en: Billing authorization is a separate IAM system. Common roles include:

items.zh: Billing Account Creator（roles/billing.creator）：组织级，只能创建自助式结算账户。控制该角色的人数，否则组织外会长出不受追踪的云开销。
items.en: Billing Account Creator (`roles/billing.creator`): an organization-level role for creating eligible self-serve billing accounts. Its assignment should be limited and reviewed.

items.zh: Billing Account Administrator（roles/billing.admin）：结算账户的 owner 角色，管理付款方式、付款资料、导出配置、成本查看、手工付款、项目链接/解链、以及结算账户上的其他角色。
items.en: Billing Account Administrator (`roles/billing.admin`): manages payment methods, billing profiles, exports, costs, payments, project links, and other billing-account roles.

items.zh: Billing Account Costs Manager（roles/billing.costsManager）：预算与成本导出，碰不到定价与付款方式。
items.en: Billing Account Costs Manager (`roles/billing.costsManager`): manages budgets and cost exports, but not pricing or payment methods.

items.zh: Billing Account Viewer（roles/billing.viewer）：只读成本与交易，通常面向财务团队。
items.en: Billing Account Viewer (`roles/billing.viewer`): read-only access to costs and transactions, often used by finance teams.

items.zh: Billing Account User（roles/billing.user）：将项目链接到结算账户，权限极窄，可广授。
items.en: Billing Account User (`roles/billing.user`): allows projects to be linked to a billing account and has a narrower scope.

items.zh: Project Billing Manager（roles/billing.projectManager）：配合 Billing Account User 完成项目挂载/解绑，不授予任何资源权限。
items.en: Project Billing Manager (`roles/billing.projectManager`): works with Billing Account User to link or unlink projects and does not grant resource permissions.

text.zh: 项目的挂载与解绑由两个角色协作完成，资源权限与付款权限在角色设计上被切开：Project Owner 可以让渡项目的结算管理权而不让渡资源访问权。
text.en: Project linking and unlinking require cooperating roles. The design separates resource access from payment authority: a Project Owner can delegate billing management without granting access to project resources.

text.zh: billing.admin 可以关闭、重新启用或移动结算账户，并管理项目关联与其他结算角色。这些是会影响付款、账单归属和服务连续性的高影响操作，应通过职责分离、审批与变更审计进行控制。评估项目结算关系时，我会同时核对结算账户的 IAM 绑定和项目的 billing 关联状态。
text.en: `billing.admin` can close, reopen, or move a billing account and manage project associations and billing roles. These high-impact actions can affect payment, billing ownership, and service continuity. They should be controlled through separation of duties, approval, and change auditing. I review billing-account IAM bindings alongside each project's billing association.

text.zh: 五、树与树之间的信任桥
text.en: 5. Trust relationships between the trees

text.zh: 三棵树之间有四座桥。
text.en: There are four main connections between the identity, resource, and billing structures.

text.zh: 第一座，域名 → organization 节点：organization 的 owner 是 Directory API customer ID，一个 Workspace/Cloud Identity 账户只能关联一个组织，邮箱侧的域是云侧树根的锚。
text.en: First, the domain anchors the organization node: the organization's owner is a Directory API customer ID, and one Workspace or Cloud Identity account can be associated with one organization.

text.zh: 第二座，超级管理员 → Organization Administrator：Workspace 超级管理员是域名所有权的验证人与找回联系人，因此默认被授予分配 IAM 角色的能力，其在 Google Cloud 侧的主要职责是把 Organization Administrator 角色授予域内合适的人。这是 Workspace 与 Cloud 管理职责的分离设计，同时是一条身份树通向资源树的固定通道。
text.en: Second, Super Admins are connected to Organization Administrator assignments. Workspace Super Admins verify and recover domain ownership and can grant IAM roles; their cloud-side responsibility commonly includes assigning Organization Administrator to appropriate domain users. This separates Workspace and Google Cloud administration while preserving a defined authorization path between them.

text.zh: 第三座，域 → 项目与结算账户的出生权：初始 allow policy 把 Project Creator 与 Billing Account Creator 授予整个域，全目录的普通用户默认就是资源树的创世用户。
text.en: Third, the domain can receive initial project-creation and billing-account-creation grants through the default allow policy. These grants determine who can create resources and billing accounts.

text.zh: 第四座，project ↔ Cloud Billing account 的动态链接：挂载与解绑随时可发生，资源树与结算树之间不是静态父子关系，而是一组可随时改写的边。
text.en: Fourth, projects can be linked to or unlinked from Cloud Billing accounts. The resource hierarchy and billing hierarchy are not a single parent-child tree; their relationship is a changeable association.

text.zh:
Workspace 域（邮箱侧）                Cloud 侧
 ┌────────────────────┐    锚定    ┌──────────────────────┐
 │ 域名 + Directory    │ ────────→ │ organization 节点      │
 │ customer ID        │           │ （owner 不可改）        │
 │                    │           └──────────────────────┘
 │ 超级管理员          │  默认可授  ┌──────────────────────┐
 │                    │ ────────→ │ Organization          │
 │                    │  OrgAdmin │ Administrator 等 IAM  │
 │ 全域普通用户        │ ────────→ │ Project Creator       │
 │                    │  初始授权  │ Billing Acct Creator  │
 └────────────────────┘           └──────────┬───────────┘
                                             │ 动态链接
                                  ┌──────────▼───────────┐
                                  │ Cloud Billing        │
                                  │ account ⇄ payments   │
                                  └──────────────────────┘
text.en:
Workspace 域（邮箱侧）                Cloud 侧
 ┌────────────────────┐    锚定    ┌──────────────────────┐
 │ 域名 + Directory    │ ────────→ │ organization 节点      │
 │ customer ID        │           │ （owner 不可改）        │
 │                    │           └──────────────────────┘
 │ 超级管理员          │  默认可授  ┌──────────────────────┐
 │                    │ ────────→ │ Organization          │
 │                    │  OrgAdmin │ Administrator 等 IAM  │
 │ 全域普通用户        │ ────────→ │ Project Creator       │
 │                    │  初始授权  │ Billing Acct Creator  │
 └────────────────────┘           └──────────┬───────────┘
                                             │ 动态链接
                                  ┌──────────▼───────────┐
                                  │ Cloud Billing        │
                                  │ account ⇄ payments   │
                                  └──────────────────────┘

text.zh: 速记
text.en: Key points

items.zh: 谷歌没有统一根：多条商务线各有一套授权面与计费面，靠域名、customer ID、payments profile 缝合。
items.en: Google has no single root object spanning all businesses; identity, cloud resources, and billing use distinct authorization systems.

items.zh: 资源树单亲规则：树内是继承，树外是显式授权；裸项目只属于免费层或未受管账号。
items.en: The resource hierarchy is single-parent. Policies inherit within it; access across its boundaries requires explicit authorization.

items.zh: 一个 Workspace/Cloud Identity 账户只关联一个组织；组织 owner 是 Directory customer ID，创建后不可改。
items.en: A Workspace or Cloud Identity account can be associated with one organization; the organization records its Directory customer ID as owner.

items.zh: 组织初始授权把 Project Creator 和 Billing Account Creator 授予整个域——域本身就是 IAM principal。
items.en: Organization defaults may grant Project Creator and Billing Account Creator to a domain, which is itself an IAM principal.

items.zh: allow、deny、organization policy 三条独立继承链，最终策略是三条链的合成。
items.en: Allow, deny, and organization policies combine to determine effective access.

items.zh: 服务凭证三条链：文件链（SA key/ADC）、协议链（WIF pool/provider）、运行时链（attached SA/元数据服务），检测信号各异。
items.en: Service credentials involve file-based credentials, federation, and runtime identities; each has different controls and audit signals.

items.zh: 短时凭据默认一小时；impersonation 在日志里成对出现主体与被模拟者，密钥文件的使用在日志里只是“它自己”。
items.en: Short-lived credentials commonly last one hour; impersonation and key-based use have different audit characteristics.

items.zh: 结算是三层：Cloud Billing account（云级）→ payments account（付款）→ payments profile（谷歌级、全家桶共享、独立权限体系）。
items.en: Billing spans Cloud Billing accounts, Google payments accounts, and Google payments profiles, each with distinct responsibilities and permissions.

items.zh: billing.admin 可 close/reopen/move/removeFromOrganization：支付路径是可搬动的控制面，不是元数据。
items.en: Billing administrators can perform actions that affect payment and project association, so those actions need governance and audit.

items.zh: 四座信任桥：域名锚定组织、超管默认可授 IAM、全域初始出生权、项目与结算账户的动态链接——Work 高于 Cloud 的结构基础。
items.en: The principal cross-tree relationships are domain-to-organization association, administrator grants, domain-level defaults, and project-to-billing links.

title.zh: 人人皆红队：AI 红队的四年
title.en: Everyone Is a Red Teamer: Four Years of AI Red Teaming

summary.zh: *门槛坍塌、双重失控，与纪律的回归*
summary.en: *Collapsing barriers, dual loss of control, and the return of discipline*

text.zh: *门槛坍塌、双重失控，与纪律的回归*
text.en: *Collapsing barriers, dual loss of control, and the return of discipline*

text.zh: 2022 年 11 月 30 日 ChatGPT 上线。到今天——2026 年 10 月 27 日——三年十个月零二十七天。
text.en: ChatGPT launched on November 30, 2022. As of today—October 27, 2026—that was three years, ten months, and twenty-seven days ago.

text.zh: 这个时间刻度我想写下来，因为它回答了一个我一直在回避的问题：AI 安全到底走到哪了。我的答案是：不到四年，大模型安全大致走完了传统网络安全十到十五年的部分历程。攻击发现、漏洞原理、横向移动、供应链攻击、零信任——传统安全花了很多年才形成的这些阶段，被压缩进了一条陡得多的曲线。
text.en: I want to mark this point in time because it helps answer a question I have been avoiding: how far has AI security come? My answer is that, in less than four years, large-model security has covered parts of a decade to a decade and a half of traditional cybersecurity. Attack discovery, vulnerability fundamentals, lateral movement, supply-chain attacks, and zero trust—stages that took traditional security years to develop—have been compressed into a much steeper curve.

text.zh: 这个过程看起来不可量化，但其实可以量化一部分：可量化的是速度，不可量化的是成熟度。
text.en: This process may look impossible to quantify, but part of it can be measured: speed can be measured; maturity cannot.

text.zh: 一、被压缩的十五年：可量化的是速度
text.en: I. Fifteen Years, Compressed: Speed Can Be Measured

text.zh: 传统安全的演进是有机的：漏洞研究、攻击链、横向移动、供应链、零信任，每一段隔着若干年，隔着一代人的经验积累。AI 安全把这条曲线压陡了：提示注入与越狱（2023）→ 间接提示注入（2023）→ Agent 工具链滥用（2024）→ MCP / A2A 协议层攻击与记忆投毒（2025）→ 供应链（slopsquatting、恶意 MCP）与 Agent 权限体系零信任（2026）。传统安全的"五段论"在 AI 语境下几乎一一对应地出现了压缩版。
text.en: Traditional security evolved organically: vulnerability research, attack chains, lateral movement, supply chains, and zero trust, with years and generations of accumulated experience between each stage. AI security has steepened that curve: prompt injection and jailbreaking (2023) → indirect prompt injection (2023) → Agent toolchain abuse (2024) → attacks at the MCP / A2A protocol layer and memory poisoning (2025) → supply-chain threats (slopsquatting, malicious MCP servers) and zero-trust permission models for Agents (2026). The “five stages” of traditional security have appeared in AI security in a compressed form, with close parallels between them.

text.zh: 数据能证明这种"快"：
text.en: The data supports the claim that this is happening quickly:

items.zh: **CVE 曲线**：2018 年全球公开约 1.8 万个 CVE，漏洞公开后平均约两个月才会被利用；到 2025 年已接近每年 5 万个，而平均漏洞在公开披露之前就已经被打——防御方彻底站到了时钟的错误一侧（[ProjectDiscovery](https://projectdiscovery.io/blog/the-vulnerability-curve-bent-with-the-ai-curve)）。Google 威胁情报同样确认，AI 正在实测层面改变漏洞发现、利用的速度和类型（[Google GTIG](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/vulnerability-discovery-and-exploitation-trends-in-the-ai-era)）。
items.en: **The CVE curve**: Around 18,000 CVEs were publicly disclosed worldwide in 2018, and vulnerabilities took an average of roughly two months to be exploited after disclosure. By 2025, the annual total was approaching 50,000, while the average vulnerability was already being exploited before public disclosure—leaving defenders on the wrong side of the clock ([ProjectDiscovery](https://projectdiscovery.io/blog/the-vulnerability-curve-bent-with-the-ai-curve)). Google Threat Intelligence has likewise confirmed that AI is changing the speed and types of vulnerability discovery and exploitation in practice ([Google GTIG](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/vulnerability-discovery-and-exploitation-trends-in-the-ai-era)).

items.zh: **Agent 攻击面**：2025 年 agentic AI 安全事件的攻击向量分布中，提示注入占 43%、记忆投毒 28%、工具滥用 19%、权限提升 10%；agentic 事件平均 23 天被发现，传统事件则是 207 天（[统计](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/evan-benjamin-a405824_for-anyone-keeping-track-of-agentic-ai-activity-7411280212304236544-wbVQ)）。发现得更快，是因为盯的人更多；但组合爆炸的速度提升得更快。
items.en: **The Agent attack surface**: In the reported distribution of attack vectors for agentic AI security incidents in 2025, prompt injection accounted for 43%, memory poisoning for 28%, tool abuse for 19%, and privilege escalation for 10%. Agentic incidents took an average of 23 days to detect, compared with 207 days for traditional incidents ([statistics](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/evan-benjamin-a405824_for-anyone-keeping-track-of-agentic-ai-activity-7411280212304236544-wbVQ)). Detection is faster because more people are watching, but the rate at which combinations multiply has increased even faster.

items.zh: **组织侧时间线**：微软 AI 红队早在 2018 年就已成立——比 ChatGPT 早四年；2023 年公开方法论（[Microsoft AI Red Team](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/08/07/microsoft-ai-red-team-building-future-of-safer-ai/)）；2025 年 1 月发布《[Lessons from Red Teaming 100 Generative AI Products](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.07238)》，把 100 个 GenAI 产品的红队经验沉淀成八条教训；2026 年 7 月，微软干脆在《[Rethinking security for the age of AI](https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/07/27/rethinking-security-for-the-age-of-ai/)》中宣布"网络安全的物理学正在改变"：自主系统可以持续推理、适应、行动，而攻击成本在下降。这条时间线本身，就是整个行业的缩影。
items.en: **The organizational timeline**: Microsoft’s AI Red Team was established as early as 2018—four years before ChatGPT—and its methodology was published in 2023 ([Microsoft AI Red Team](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/08/07/microsoft-ai-red-team-building-future-of-safer-ai/)). In January 2025, Microsoft published *[Lessons from Red Teaming 100 Generative AI Products](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.07238)*, distilling red-team experience across 100 GenAI products into eight lessons. In July 2026, Microsoft stated in *[Rethinking security for the age of AI](https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/07/27/rethinking-security-for-the-age-of-ai/)* that “the physics of cybersecurity is changing”: autonomous systems can reason, adapt, and act continuously, while the cost of attacks is falling. This timeline reflects the industry as a whole.

text.zh: 不可量化的部分是成熟度：检测覆盖率、应急响应、责任认定、法律边界——这些依赖组织与人的东西，没有跟着四年一起压缩。被压缩的是攻击技术，滞后的是防御体系。
text.en: The part that cannot be measured is maturity: detection coverage, incident response, accountability, and legal boundaries. These depend on organizations and people, and they have not been compressed into the same four years. Attack techniques have accelerated; defensive systems have lagged behind.

text.zh: 二、门槛坍塌：人人都是红队
text.en: II. Barriers Collapse: Everyone Is a Red Teamer

text.zh: 三年前我信誓旦旦地说：未来十年 AI 都替代不了红队。现在回看，这个判断的认知水平极其低下——错就错在，我把红队当成了"知识集合"。而知识，恰好是 AI 最擅长压缩和复刻的东西。
text.en: Three years ago, I confidently said AI would not replace red teams for the next decade. Looking back, that was a profoundly poor judgment. I was wrong because I treated red teaming as a “body of knowledge”—and knowledge is precisely what AI is best at compressing and reproducing.

text.zh: 今天，只要会 Agent 开发，就能成为红队：AI 清楚传统红队的一切，甚至能举一反三——你给它一个目标，它能把攻击面枚举、payload 生成、规避、横向的全链路自动串起来。小声说一句：我一度觉得自己要失业了。
text.en: Today, anyone who can build an Agent can become a red teamer: AI has absorbed much of traditional red teaming and can even generalize from it. Give it a target, and it can connect the full chain—from attack-surface enumeration and payload generation to evasion and lateral movement—into an automated workflow. Quietly, I admit that for a while I thought I might lose my job.

text.zh: 这不是预言，是正在发生的现实。今年 9 月底到 10 月初，韩国至少九家银行遭攻击，七家金融机构确认数据泄露，约 6.8 万名客户信息被窃——新韩银行约 2.5 万人、Yegaram 储蓄银行约 4 万人、KB 国民银行 119 人（[韩联社](https://cn.yna.co.kr/view/ACK20261004000800881)）。CrowdStrike 追踪显示，攻击者使用的是 AI 驱动渗透工具 ARTEX（[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/blog/unknown-threat-actor-uses-artex-to-target-south-korean-finance/)）；该工具在韩国被与多起银行攻击关联后，开发方承认被"恶意行为者"滥用并停止开源（[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD/20261009-%E9%9F%A9%E5%9B%BD%E5%A4%9A%E5%AE%B6%E9%93%B6%E8%A1%8C%E9%81%AD%E9%BB%91%E5%AE%A2%E6%94%BB%E5%87%BB%E5%90%8E-%E4%B8%80%E6%AC%BE%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BDai%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7)）。攻击者还使用了 Claude Code 等 AI 工具，嫌疑人据报可能是一名 26 岁、身处中国的男子（[纽约时报中文网](https://cn.nytimes.com/asia-pacific/20261009/south-korea-bank-hack-china-us-ai/)）。
text.en: This is not a prediction; it is already happening. From late September to early October this year, at least nine banks in South Korea were attacked. Seven financial institutions confirmed data breaches, exposing information on about 68,000 customers: around 25,000 at Shinhan Bank, 40,000 at Yegaram Savings Bank, and 119 at KB Kookmin Bank ([Yonhap News](https://cn.yna.co.kr/view/ACK20261004000800881)). CrowdStrike reported that the attackers used an AI-driven penetration-testing tool called ARTEX ([CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/blog/unknown-threat-actor-uses-artex-to-target-south-korean-finance/)). After the tool was linked to multiple attacks on South Korean banks, its developers acknowledged that it had been abused by “malicious actors” and discontinued its open-source release ([RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD/20261009-%E9%9F%A9%E5%9B%BD%E5%A4%9A%E5%AE%B6%E9%93%B6%E8%A1%8C%E9%81%AD%E9%BB%91%E5%AE%A2%E6%94%BB%E5%87%BB%E5%90%8E-%E4%B8%80%E6%AC%BE%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BDai%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7)). The attackers also used AI tools such as Claude Code. The suspect was reportedly a 26-year-old man based in China ([The New York Times Chinese](https://cn.nytimes.com/asia-pacific/20261009/south-korea-bank-hack-china-us-ai/)).

text.zh: ARTEX 的故事，是"人人都是红队"最直白的注脚：一个不需要自己写 exploit 的人，借助 AI 在韩国金融体系上撕开了一道口子。银行守住了核心系统，失守的是生态——这恰恰是 AI 把攻击成本打到地板之后，所有人都要面对的现实。
text.en: ARTEX is a stark illustration of “everyone is a red teamer”: someone who did not need to write exploits themselves used AI to breach parts of South Korea’s financial ecosystem. The banks protected their core systems, but the surrounding ecosystem was compromised. That is the reality everyone must confront as AI drives the cost of attacks down.

text.zh: 同期，CSA 的研究记录显示，自主 AI 红队已从研究演示走向商业产品——能够在生产系统上独立发现并验证可利用漏洞，不再需要人类操作员逐步指挥（[CSA](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-ai-autonomous-red-team-agent-findings-2026/)）。四年之间，红队从"手艺"变成了"水电"。
text.en: At the same time, research from CSA indicates that autonomous AI red teaming has moved from research demonstrations to commercial products—systems that can independently discover and validate exploitable vulnerabilities in production environments, without an operator directing every step ([CSA](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-ai-autonomous-red-team-agent-findings-2026/)). In four years, red teaming has gone from a “craft” to a utility.

text.zh: 三、协作形态：从团队到 Agent
text.en: III. The Shape of Collaboration: From Teams to Agents

text.zh: AI 红队对我最大的感受之一：往后不再以团队协作为中心，而是以 Agent 协作为中心。拼的不是十个人怎么配合，而是你在 AI 场景下的进攻设计，加上传统安全沉淀出来的判断力——哪里有信任边界、哪里会出权限问题。
text.en: One of my strongest impressions of AI red teaming is that collaboration will increasingly center on Agents rather than teams. The differentiator will not be how ten people coordinate, but how well you design offensive work in an AI context and combine it with the judgment built through years of security practice—where trust boundaries lie and where authorization can fail.

text.zh: 但我同样清醒：这个窗口可能只有几年。传统安全经验正在被 AI 逐渐替代——人不可能和机器比。AI 越强，人越要往上游走：定义目标、定义伤害、定义停止条件，而不是比拼枚举速度。
text.en: I am also clear-eyed about this: the window may last only a few years. AI is gradually replacing parts of traditional security experience; people cannot compete with machines on speed. As AI grows more capable, people need to move upstream: defining objectives, defining harm, and defining stop conditions, rather than competing over enumeration speed.

text.zh: 四、双重不可控
text.en: IV. Dual Loss of Control

text.zh: AI 业务场景的暴露面比传统 Web 时代更广：模型、RAG、Agent、工具、记忆、编排协议，每一个都是新面。而且越来越难说"漏洞还是人能控制的东西"：传统软件漏洞是可枚举的点，AI 场景的漏洞是组合出来的面。无论是 CVE 漏洞库的增速，还是 AWS AgentCore 暴露出来的问题，都在往同一个方向恶化。
text.en: The exposure surface of AI business systems is broader than that of the traditional web era: models, RAG, Agents, tools, memory, and orchestration protocols are all new surfaces. It is also becoming harder to say that vulnerabilities remain within the bounds of what people can control. Traditional software vulnerabilities are enumerable points; vulnerabilities in AI systems emerge from combinations across the surface. Both the growth in the CVE database and the issues exposed in AWS AgentCore point in the same troubling direction.

text.zh: AWS AgentCore 的案例很典型：Unit 42 发现 AgentCore Harness 的默认工具配置允许一次间接提示注入升级为明文凭据窃取——内置工具以 root 运行，还与解密 vault 凭据的进程共享内存空间（[CSA / Unit 42](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-aws-agentcore-credential-exfiltration-2026/)）。SDK 层也被发现存在可让攻击者在 AI 沙箱内执行命令、触达 AWS 凭据的缺陷（[Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/aws-agentcore-sdk-flaws-ai/)）。同期还有 agentjacking：通过 MCP 注入，劫持接入 Sentry 的 AI 编码 Agent（[Tenet Security / CSA](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-agentjacking-mcp-sentry-injection-20260612/)）。
text.en: The AWS AgentCore case is illustrative: Unit 42 found that AgentCore Harness’s default tool configuration could allow a single indirect prompt injection to escalate into plaintext credential theft—the built-in tool ran as root and shared a memory space with the process that decrypted vault credentials ([CSA / Unit 42](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-aws-agentcore-credential-exfiltration-2026/)). At the SDK layer, flaws were also found that could let an attacker execute commands inside an AI sandbox and access AWS credentials ([Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/aws-agentcore-sdk-flaws-ai/)). Around the same time, agentjacking used MCP injection to hijack an AI coding Agent integrated with Sentry ([Tenet Security / CSA](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-agentjacking-mcp-sentry-injection-20260612/)).

text.zh: 人会犯错，这一点几千年没变过；过去机器犯错是可控的——边界清楚、后果可预测。现在，机器的"错误"本身就是攻击面。当人和机器这两个不可控因素叠加：人写了一个疏忽的 prompt，agent 在无人监督下把它执行成供应链投毒——整条链上没有任何一环是"计划内的恶意"，但结果已经发生。这种爆炸半径，我很难想象要怎么估算。
text.en: People have made mistakes for millennia; that has not changed. In the past, machine failures were more controllable: boundaries were clear and consequences more predictable. Now, a machine’s “mistake” is itself part of the attack surface. When two uncontrollable factors—people and machines—combine, someone may write a careless prompt and an Agent may execute it without supervision, turning it into supply-chain poisoning. No one in the chain may have intended harm, yet the consequences are real. I find it difficult to imagine how to estimate that blast radius.

text.zh: 五、铁律：红队的 AI 必须被关进笼子
text.en: V. A Rule: Red-Team AI Must Be Kept in a Cage

text.zh: 所以就目前而言，AI 红队的第一专注点不是能力，是纪律。
text.en: For now, the first priority in AI red teaming is not capability; it is discipline.

text.zh: 能力上不需要怀疑：AI 的知识面一定比你强。正因如此，AI 红队使用的 AI 必须受控制、被监控、被限制，不能掉以轻心。如果传统 AI 应用的安全规则是十条，AI 红队的规则必须是 10+1——多出来的那一条，是对武器本身的管理：红队 AI 接触的是未公开漏洞、客户内网拓扑和真实凭据，它的每一次工具调用，破坏力都比普通应用大一个数量级。
text.en: There is little doubt about AI’s breadth of knowledge. For that very reason, AI used in red teaming must be controlled, monitored, and constrained; it cannot be treated casually. If the security rules for a conventional AI application number ten, the rules for AI red teaming need to be “10+1.” The extra rule governs the weapon itself: red-team AI may access undisclosed vulnerabilities, client network topologies, and real credentials. Every tool call it makes can have an order of magnitude more destructive potential than one from an ordinary application.

text.zh: 第二，经验必须资产化。一定要针对性地收集每一次进攻的经验——prompt 怎么写的、链路怎么串的、被哪一层拦下的、怎么绕过去的。这些经验无论复用还是回溯，都是最宝贵的资产。AI 会换代、会幻觉，但沉淀下来的攻击语料和判断框架不会——微软能从 100 个产品里写出一本书，靠的正是这种资产化能力。
text.en: Second, experience must be turned into an asset. Every engagement’s lessons should be collected deliberately: how prompts were written, how the chain was assembled, which layer stopped it, and how it was bypassed. Whether used for reuse or for retrospective analysis, these lessons are among the most valuable assets. AI models will change and hallucinate, but accumulated attack corpora and judgment frameworks will endure. Microsoft’s ability to distill a book’s worth of lessons from 100 products rests on precisely this kind of institutionalization.

text.zh: 第三，武器管理。AI 红队的武器库，在 AI 场景下就是真的武器库：提示词、越狱模板、工具、payload、agent 编排。既要防泄漏——红队的 prompt 外流就是军火外流；也要防滥用——ARTEX 从红队工具变成犯罪工具，中间只隔了一个开源仓库的距离。工具没有立场，但管理工具的人必须有。
text.en: Third, weapon management. In the context of AI, an AI red team’s arsenal really is an arsenal: prompts, jailbreak templates, tools, payloads, and Agent orchestration. It must be protected from leaks—a red-team prompt leaking is equivalent to a weapons leak—and from abuse. ARTEX went from a red-team tool to a criminal tool with only an open-source repository in between. Tools have no position; the people who manage them must.

text.zh: 结语
text.en: Conclusion

text.zh: 回到三年前的我。那句"十年内 AI 替代不了红队"，错在把"人"和"知识"混为一谈。知识会被压缩，工具会民主化，门槛会坍塌；但定义伤害的能力、设定边界的权力、以及知道什么时候该停手的纪律，眼下还是人的活。
text.en: Looking back at myself three years ago, my claim that “AI would not replace red teams for ten years” was wrong because I conflated “people” with “knowledge.” Knowledge can be compressed, tools democratized, and barriers collapsed. But the ability to define harm, the authority to set boundaries, and the discipline to know when to stop still belong to people—for now.

text.zh: AI 的车轮碾过来时，红队这个职业不会消失，但它会被重写：从少数精英的手艺，变成人人可用的杠杆；再从杠杆，变成需要纪律约束的武器。越是在失控的边缘，越要有人记得——武器库的钥匙，得锁在笼子里。
text.en: As AI’s wheels roll forward, the red-team profession will not disappear, but it will be rewritten: from a craft practiced by a small group of experts, to leverage available to everyone, and then into a weapon that requires discipline. The closer we get to losing control, the more important it is to remember: the key to the armory must stay locked in the cage.

title.en: Microsoft 365, Copilot, and the Security Control Plane

summary.zh: 本文梳理 Microsoft 365 的多层授权体系、它与 Azure 的边界、各工作负载的访问通道、Graph 应用权限、Copilot 的数据访问范围，以及 Sentinel、Purview、Defender 与 Intune 的控制面。
summary.en: This article reviews Microsoft 365's layered authorization model, its boundaries with Azure, workload access paths, Microsoft Graph application permissions, Copilot data access, and the control planes for Sentinel, Purview, Defender, and Intune.

text.zh: 上一篇讨论了身份、资源与账单边界。本文进一步梳理 Microsoft 365 工作负载自身的授权体系、它与 Azure 的交界、Copilot 的数据访问范围，以及 Sentinel、Purview、Defender、Intune 等安全与管理服务。
text.en: The previous article covered identity, resource, and billing boundaries. This article examines Microsoft 365 workload authorization, its relationship with Azure, Copilot's data access, and security and management services such as Sentinel, Purview, Defender, and Intune.

text.zh: 一、M365 的认证体系：一个身份，多个授权层
text.en: 1. Microsoft 365 authentication and authorization layers

text.zh: M365 是一组工作负载——Exchange Online、SharePoint Online、OneDrive、Teams、Office 应用。它们的认证没有自己的一套：登录、MFA、条件访问、令牌签发，全部由上一篇讲过的 Entra 租户承担。M365 特有的是授权层，而且不止一层。
text.en: Microsoft 365 consists of workloads such as Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Office applications. Entra handles sign-in, MFA, Conditional Access, and token issuance. Authorization, however, is implemented through multiple systems that developed independently and are managed in different service portals.

text.zh: Microsoft 365 包含多套独立发展的基于角色的访问控制系统，各自面向不同工作负载。Exchange 角色组、SharePoint 站点权限和 Teams 策略并不共享一套授权模型；Entra 管理中心提供部分统一管理入口，但不能替代各服务自身的权限视图。
text.en: Microsoft 365 has several independently developed role-based authorization systems, each with its own administrative portal. This explains why Exchange has role groups, SharePoint has site permissions, and Teams has policies: these are not one shared authorization model merely because the Entra admin center surfaces some of their roles.

text.zh: Entra 内置角色按作用范围分三类。第一类是 Entra ID 专属角色，只管目录里的东西，比如用户管理员、应用管理员；第二类是服务专属角色——为 M365 各服务在 Entra 里定义的角色，Exchange Administrator 管邮箱、Intune Administrator 管设备策略、SharePoint Administrator 管站点集、Teams Administrator 管服务；第三类是跨服务角色，Global Administrator 与 Global Reader 被多个 M365 服务承认，Security Administrator、Security Reader、Compliance Administrator 横跨多个安全与合规服务。Exchange Administrator 在 Entra 里的角色与 Exchange RBAC 系统中的 Organization Management 角色组有对应关系——同一份权限，两个入口；具体权限仍按当前角色定义核对。
text.en: Entra roles fall into three broad groups. Directory roles, such as User Administrator and Application Administrator, manage directory objects. Service-specific roles, such as Exchange Administrator, Intune Administrator, SharePoint Administrator, and Teams Administrator, manage their respective workloads. Cross-service roles, including Global Administrator, Global Reader, Security Administrator, Security Reader, and Compliance Administrator, are recognized across several Microsoft 365 security and compliance services. Some Entra roles map to workload roles—for example, Exchange Administrator has a relationship to the Exchange Organization Management role group—but the effective permissions should be checked against current role definitions.

text.zh: 在 Entra 角色之下，每个工作负载还有自己的内部体系：Exchange 的角色组与管理角色、SharePoint 按站点/库/条目层层继承的权限模型、Teams 的策略与外部访问配置。再往下是应用同意层——应用获授 Graph 应用权限后，可以不依赖某个具体用户而以应用身份访问对应 API；有效范围取决于权限类型、管理员同意与可用的资源范围控制。最底下是设备层：Intune 的合规状态写回设备对象，条件访问把它当访问决策的信号。
text.en: Each workload also has its own authorization system: Exchange role groups and management roles, SharePoint permissions at site, library, and item levels, and Teams policies and external-access settings. Application consent is another layer. A Microsoft Graph application permission can allow an application to access API data without a specific user, subject to the permission type, administrator consent, and any supported resource-scope controls. Intune compliance state is a device signal that Conditional Access can evaluate.

text.zh: 评估 M365 访问时，应分别检查 Entra 角色、工作负载自身的权限模型、应用同意（Graph 权限），以及由 Intune 提供并由条件访问评估的设备合规信号。合并这些视图后，才能判断账号及应用的实际有效权限。
text.en: When reviewing Microsoft 365 access, I separate Entra roles, workload-specific permissions, application consent, and device-compliance conditions. The access model is not fully represented in any one portal.

text.zh: Entra 管理中心提供 M365 权限的部分入口，但并不覆盖全部授权。Exchange 角色组、SharePoint 站点权限、Teams 策略和 Graph 应用同意都需分别审查；目录中未发现高权限角色，并不能证明工作负载中不存在高权限。
text.en: The Entra admin center is an entry point to Microsoft 365 permissions, not a complete inventory. Exchange role groups, SharePoint site permissions, Teams policies, and Graph application consent need separate review.

text.zh: 二、M365 与 Azure：同一目录，两套体系
text.en: 2. Microsoft 365 and Azure: shared identity, separate authorization

text.zh: M365 与 Azure 共享身份平面，但授权平面各自独立。两边可以使用同一个 Entra 租户及其用户、组、应用与设备；Azure 资源由 Azure RBAC 管理，M365 工作负载则由各服务的权限模型管理。订阅 Owner 不因此获得邮箱权限，Exchange Administrator 也不因此获得虚拟机权限。
text.en: Microsoft 365 and Azure share an Entra tenant, users, groups, applications, and devices, but they have different authorization planes. Azure RBAC governs Azure resources; Microsoft 365 workloads use the models described above. A subscription Owner does not thereby manage mailboxes, and an Exchange Administrator does not thereby control virtual machines.

text.zh: 在此之上有一批横跨两边的关联体系：
text.en: Several systems connect the two sides:

items.zh: 身份与策略：条件访问在 Entra 里定义，目标应用既可以选 M365 的 Exchange、SharePoint，也可以选 Azure 管理 API——同一份策略同时约束两个平面。设备合规这条信号链也是横跨的：Intune 上报合规，Entra 评估，两边同时生效。
items.en: **Identity and policy:** Conditional Access is configured in Entra and can target Microsoft 365 services as well as Azure management APIs. Intune reports device compliance to Entra, where Conditional Access can evaluate it.

items.zh: API：Microsoft Graph 是 M365 的统一 API（也是 Copilot 的取数通道），Azure 资源管理走 ARM API。Graph 也暴露部分 Azure 目录信息，但资源操作仍以 ARM 为准。
items.en: **APIs:** Microsoft Graph is a primary API for Microsoft 365; Azure resource management uses ARM. Graph exposes some directory information, but Azure resource operations remain under ARM.

items.zh: 合规平面：Purview 覆盖 M365 内容（Exchange、SharePoint、OneDrive、Teams），并为部分 Azure 数据源提供分类、标签或治理能力；具体支持范围取决于数据源与功能。
items.en: **Compliance:** Purview covers Microsoft 365 content and supports selected Azure data sources, depending on the feature and source.

items.zh: 安全平面：Defender XDR 防护 M365 的邮件、身份与端点，Defender for Cloud 防护 Azure 资源，Sentinel 把两边的数据都收进一个工作区。
items.en: **Security:** Defender XDR covers Microsoft 365 security workloads, Defender for Cloud protects Azure and supported multicloud resources, and Sentinel can ingest signals from both.

items.zh: 设备平面：Intune 是 M365 的端点管理服务，但设备对象注册在 Entra，合规信号喂给条件访问，条件访问又同时管 M365 与 Azure。
items.en: **Devices:** Intune manages endpoints, device records are registered in Entra, and compliance signals can affect access to Microsoft 365 and Azure.

text.zh: 还有一个容易被忽略的结构性事实：M365 的许可挂在用户与租户上，不依赖 Azure 订阅；但 Sentinel、Defender for Cloud 这类安全服务跑在 Azure 订阅里。一个纯 M365 的组织，它的安全栈也往往跨进了 Azure 订阅的边界——“M365 租户的安全运营”与“某几个 Azure 订阅”是绑在一起的。计费树（上篇）同样各自独立：M365 有自己的商业订阅，Azure 走自己的计费账户。
text.en: Microsoft 365 licensing is associated with users and the tenant and does not require an Azure subscription. Sentinel and Defender for Cloud, however, run in Azure subscription contexts. A Microsoft 365 security operation may therefore depend on one or more Azure subscriptions, while its commercial subscription and Azure billing account remain separate.

text.zh: 三、M365 服务的访问通道
text.en: 3. Microsoft 365 workload access paths

text.zh: 每一类通道都是官方功能；理解它们的存在比记住任何具体命令都重要。按“数据怎么出来”给每个工作负载归位，并标出各自的审计口径。
text.en: Each workload has distinct data-access paths and audit records. The relevant question is how data is accessed and which control records that access.

text.zh: 3.1 Exchange Online：三条读取通道
text.en: 3.1 Exchange Online: three access paths

text.zh: 邮箱数据有几类彼此独立的官方访问通道。第一类是委托访问：用户把自己的邮箱或日历委托给别人，或被加入有邮箱权限的组。第二类是应用访问：应用可通过 Graph 应用权限以应用身份访问邮件；权限通常由租户管理员同意，默认授权范围可能覆盖租户内邮箱，但 Exchange Online 的 RBAC for Applications 等范围控制可以限制访问。第三类是合规管理员通道：Purview 的 eDiscovery Manager 可在组织范围内搜索其获授权的内容位置并导出结果，具体范围受案例成员身份、角色和搜索权限过滤等配置限制。Exchange Online 的 ApplicationImpersonation 管理角色已于 2025 年 2 月退役，不应再当作现行通道；存量遗留应用要单独核查迁移状态。
text.en: Mailbox access can arise from user delegation, application access, or compliance administration. Applications may use Microsoft Graph application permissions, subject to tenant consent and supported scope controls such as Exchange Online RBAC for Applications. Purview eDiscovery Manager can search and export authorized content locations, subject to case membership, role assignments, and search filters. Exchange Online's ApplicationImpersonation role was retired in February 2025 and should not be treated as a current access path; legacy applications should be checked for migration.

text.zh: 三条通道的审计口径完全不同。委托访问是配置问题，审计对象是逐邮箱的委托与权限记录。应用访问是凭据与同意问题：一把被管理员同意过的应用凭据可以在不触发任何用户侧登录异常的情况下访问邮件，作用范围只受同意与范围控制约束——盘点时问的不是“有没有登录”，而是“这个应用被同意到哪一步”。管理员通道最直接也最显眼：eDiscovery 的搜索与导出在审计里留痕很重，但它按设计就是成规模的筛选与导出能力，异常与否取决于基线，而不是动作本身。
text.en: These paths have different audit implications. Delegation is a per-mailbox configuration issue. Application access depends on consent and credentials, so review the permissions granted to each application rather than relying only on user sign-in events. eDiscovery search and export are designed to handle large data sets; whether a given operation is unusual depends on the organization's baseline.

text.zh: 另外，邮箱规则与转发设置是工作负载自己的配置面：收件箱规则可以在邮箱所有者不做任何操作的情况下把内容转发出去，或把特定发件人（安全告警、财务邮件）静默归档。它们不出现在目录角色里，是权限盘点时必须单独覆盖的配置面——清点口径是逐邮箱查规则与转发，而不是查目录日志。
text.en: Mailbox rules and forwarding settings are another workload-level configuration surface. Rules can forward or move messages without a directory-role change. Review mailbox rules and forwarding settings directly, in addition to directory logs.

text.zh: 3.2 SharePoint 与 OneDrive：继承与共享
text.en: 3.2 SharePoint and OneDrive: inheritance and sharing

text.zh: SharePoint 的权限模型按站点、库、条目层层继承，任何一层都可以断开继承自定义权限。这个设计的代价是“权限债”：多年来按项目临时共享出去的链接、拉进来的 guest、断继承后没人回收的授权，全部沉淀在站点里。应用面对应的是文件类的 Graph 应用权限（Files、Sites 系列）。外部共享的形态——任何人链接、特定 guest、组织内链接——决定了每一份内容的实际可见面。
text.en: SharePoint permissions can be inherited from sites, libraries, or items, or customized when inheritance is broken. Temporary sharing, guest access, and forgotten unique permissions can accumulate over time. Graph application permissions for files and sites add another access path. External sharing settings—anyone links, specific guests, or organization links—affect the actual visibility of content.

text.zh: 权限债就是“合法可见面”：不需要提权，只需要找到一个被过度授权的普通用户或应用，搜索与 AI 汇聚会替他把可见面里的东西全部翻出来。审计可见面必须用用户自己的权限视角（而不是管理员视角）去枚举可见的站点与文件——两者经常差出一个数量级。清点“任何人链接”与断继承站点，是 Copilot 上线前必须完成的功课。
text.en: This accumulated permission state can make existing access easier to discover and aggregate, including through AI tools. To assess user-visible content, evaluate permissions from the user's perspective as well as from an administrator's. Review anyone links and sites with broken inheritance before deploying Copilot.

text.zh: 3.3 Teams：跨组织的边缘
text.en: 3.3 Teams: cross-organization collaboration

text.zh: Teams 的策略面里，与边界相关的主要是三块：与外部组织的联邦、guest 邀请、共享频道。共享频道尤其值得注意——它依赖上一篇讲过的跨租户访问设置，等于在两个租户之间开了一条内容级的通道，边界的宽窄完全由两边的信任配置决定。应用面则是频道消息类的 Graph 应用权限。Teams 还补上了邮件审计里看不到的一块协作图：共享频道里的内容与成员关系，往往能还原出组织里谁和谁在做什么。
text.en: Teams boundary settings include federation with external organizations, guest invitations, and shared channels. Shared channels rely on cross-tenant access settings and provide a content-level collaboration path between tenants. Graph application permissions also cover message-related data. Membership and shared-channel content can provide context that is not visible in mailbox audit alone.

text.zh: 3.4 Graph 应用权限：通用钥匙
text.en: 3.4 Graph application permissions

text.zh: 把上面几个服务放在一起看，同一个模式反复出现：应用注册、授予同意、凭据换 token、以应用身份访问工作负载。Graph 应用权限是 M365 上的重要访问面——获授 Mail.Read 或 Files.Read.All 并完成管理员同意的应用，通常能访问相应 API 的组织数据；实际范围还可能受 Exchange 应用 RBAC、应用访问策略或具体 API 能力约束。应用凭据本身不自动等于全租户数据权限，但“被同意的权限 + 一把凭据”的组合就是这个应用的真实作用面。
text.en: The common pattern across workloads is application registration, consent, credential use to obtain a token, and access to a workload API. Applications with Mail.Read or Files.Read.All may access corresponding organizational data after consent, but the effective scope can be constrained by Exchange application RBAC, application access policies, or API-specific capabilities.

text.zh: 这把钥匙的发放门槛是同意体系：哪些应用允许用户自行同意、哪些必须管理员同意、同意时的审核流程——这些配置决定了“同意钓鱼”面对的是一扇门还是一堵墙。具体形态很固定：诱导用户对一个伪装成生产工具的应用授权，拿到的是用户级权限；诱导管理员同意，拿到的是应用级权限，且默认作用面更宽。权限的粒度、有效期的长短、凭据的轮换，共同决定这把钥匙被复制后的暴露窗口。
text.en: The consent process controls which applications users can approve, which require administrator consent, and how consent is reviewed. User consent and administrator consent grant different permission types and should be governed accordingly. Permission scope, duration, and credential rotation affect exposure if an application credential is compromised.

text.zh: 盘点 M365 的应用面固定查三样：租户里被同意的第三方应用列表（尤其是拿到 Mail.Read、Files.Read.All 这个级别权限的）、应用注册上有没有近期新增的凭据（证书比 secret 更不显眼）、以及同意策略是否允许用户自助同意。给别人的应用注册补一个凭据，是不新增对象的最安静持久化之一。
text.en: Review the tenant's consented third-party applications, recent application credentials, and user-consent settings. An application credential alone does not grant tenant-wide data access; its effective permissions depend on consent and the relevant resource-scope controls.

text.zh: 3.5 审计与取证
text.en: 3.5 Audit and investigation

text.zh: Purview Audit 记录多个 M365 工作负载及受支持功能的活动，是这一节所有通道的事后观测面，但不保证记录每一种操作或完整权限状态。审计本身也是一个管理面：日志保留策略、搜索权限、导出权限都是配置。eDiscovery 的搜索与导出既是取证通道，也是一条把内容批量带出组织的官方出口——能力与风险是同一件事的两面，控制它的手段是角色、案例成员资格、范围过滤与审计。不同工作负载的审计事件覆盖与保留时长并不一致，评估“有没有留下痕迹”要按工作负载分别核对。
text.en: Purview Audit records activity for supported Microsoft 365 workloads and features, but it does not capture every operation or provide a complete view of permission state. Audit configuration, retention, search privileges, and export privileges are themselves administrative controls. eDiscovery search and export are legitimate compliance functions, so assess their use against roles, case membership, scope filters, and the organization's normal activity.

text.zh: 评估 M365 的暴露面，四层授权（Entra 角色、工作负载 RBAC、应用同意、设备合规）加上审计配置，缺一层就是盲区。统一审计日志是横跨这四层最重要的观测点；做访问审查时先按工作负载把审计覆盖列一遍，再判断哪条通道的痕迹最薄。
text.en: Review audit coverage and retention by workload. A unified audit service does not mean that every workload records every event in the same way or for the same period.

text.zh: 四、Copilot：AI 体系的取数边界与风险面
text.en: 4. Copilot: data access boundaries and risks

text.zh: 4.1 Copilot 如何取数
text.en: 4.1 How Copilot accesses data

text.zh: Copilot 的架构拆成四件事。第一，Copilot 的价值来自把大语言模型连接到组织数据，而它访问内容与上下文的通道是 Microsoft Graph——用户文档、邮件、日历、聊天、会议、联系人都在 Graph 里。第二，语义索引为 Copilot 提供检索的 grounding 数据，它按用户意图扩展检索范围，并且遵守用户权限。第三，有一条用加粗写下的安全边界：**Copilot 只呈现单个用户至少拥有查看权限的组织数据**——支撑这个边界的是 M365 各服务自己的权限模型（包括共享频道这类跨租户协作给出的权限）。第四，扩展性：智能体（agents）与 Graph 连接器把组织外部与第三方数据接进 Copilot 的可及范围；启用智能体后，Copilot 会代表用户向智能体发起查询。
text.en: Copilot combines a language model with organizational data. Microsoft Graph provides access to documents, email, calendars, chats, meetings, and contacts. Semantic indexing supports retrieval and grounding while respecting user permissions. Microsoft states that Copilot surfaces organizational data the user is permitted to view; the underlying workload permissions, including cross-tenant collaboration permissions, remain relevant. Agents and Graph connectors can bring external or third-party data into scope, and their behavior depends on their identity and configuration.

text.zh: 隐私侧：提示、响应与经 Graph 访问的数据不会被用来训练基础大模型；Copilot 的交互数据与组织在 M365 的其他内容按同样的契约边界处理。防护侧，内置措施包括对提示注入（越狱）类攻击的拦截与有害内容的拦截。
text.en: Prompts, responses, and data accessed through Graph are not used to train foundation models under Microsoft's stated Microsoft 365 Copilot data-protection commitments. Built-in safeguards address prompt injection and harmful content, but they are one layer of defense rather than a guarantee against every attack.

text.zh: 4.2 风险面：五条
text.en: 4.2 Five areas of risk

text.zh: Copilot 的风险面几乎全部由“既有权限体系 + 新的数据汇聚与执行层”组合而成，拆成五条。
text.en: Copilot combines existing permissions with a new retrieval and interaction layer. Its risks are best assessed through that combination.

text.zh: 第一条是权限放大。Copilot 不改变权限，它改变的是汇聚速度：一个高可见度的身份（高管助理、IT 与合规类角色、被过度授权的普通用户），过去要靠人工翻 SharePoint 和邮箱才能拼出的情报，现在一句提示就能完成聚合。目标价值因此从“找数据”转移到“找身份”——谁的可见面大，谁就是 Copilot 场景里的高价值对象。防范重心跟着转移：高可见度身份的权限收敛，优先级高于普通用户。
text.en: First, **permission amplification**: Copilot does not inherently change access rights, but can make information already visible to a user faster to find and summarize. High-visibility accounts and users with broad access therefore warrant careful permission review.

text.zh: 第二条是权限债的兑现。既然 Copilot 只呈现用户有权查看的内容，那么它暴露的其实就是组织多年沉淀的过度共享：开了“任何人”链接的站点、断继承后没人管的库、随手拉进来的 guest。用 M365 服务的权限模型确保正确的人访问正确的内容——这句防御原则反过来读，就是 Copilot 数据面的全部内容。审计 Copilot 的暴露面，等价于审计整个权限模型。
text.en: Second, **accumulated sharing**: Copilot can surface content that has been over-shared through anyone links, broken inheritance, or unnecessary guest access. Reviewing Copilot exposure consequently requires reviewing the underlying Microsoft 365 permissions.

text.zh: 第三条是间接提示注入。Copilot 的 grounding 会把用户有权访问的内容带进提示上下文，于是文档、邮件或 Teams 消息中的恶意指令可能影响模型输出或后续处理。注入的候选载体不需要什么高深技术——隐藏文本、批注、文档元数据、图片替代文字，凡是 Copilot 能读到、而用户肉眼不会注意的角落都算。提示注入防护是纵深防御的一层，不代表对所有攻击免疫。可能的影响取决于产品、连接身份和可用能力：从误导回答、呈现用户有权访问但不应被汇总的信息，到在具备动作能力且授权允许的智能体中触发非预期操作。
text.en: Third, **indirect prompt injection**: instructions embedded in documents, email, or Teams content may influence model output or subsequent processing. Potential effects depend on the product, connected identity, and available actions, from misleading responses to unintended actions by an authorized agent. Prompt-injection safeguards should be treated as defense in depth.

text.zh: 第四条是智能体与连接器——新的数据访问与执行面。智能体不一定拥有独立服务身份：它可根据产品类型和配置，以用户委托身份、连接所有者身份或应用身份访问数据或调用操作。Graph 连接器把外部数据接入 Graph，并需正确配置访问控制与安全裁剪。于是评估一个组织的 AI 面，就变成清点这些新身份与连接：谁创建了哪些智能体、它们以什么身份运行、连了哪些数据源、凭据怎么管、权限谁审。AI 体系没有发明新的权限模型，但它把“清点服务账号与连接”这件老工作放大出一个增长极快的新入口——不能把所有智能体都概括成新的服务账号，但每一个都值得按服务账号的标准盘一遍。
text.en: Fourth, **agents and connectors**: agents may use delegated user identity, a connection owner's identity, or an application identity, depending on product and configuration. Graph connectors bring external content into search and need appropriate access controls and security trimming. Inventory the agents, identities, data sources, credentials, and authorization owners.

text.zh: 第五条是从 Copilot 到 Azure 与本地。Microsoft 365 Copilot 的原生 M365 grounding 不会因为用户使用 Copilot 就自动获得 Azure RBAC；但智能体、插件或连接器可以按其配置连接外部服务或 API。跨到 Azure 或本地的能力取决于连接所用身份、授权和配置，而不是简单由 Graph 一条边界决定。结合上篇的结论：Copilot 是汇聚加速器，不是边界突破器——它加速汇总已有权限可访问的数据，而通向 Azure 与本地的路仍然是身份与凭据（Entra 角色、Graph 权限、Azure RBAC、混合链）。
text.en: Fifth, **connections to Azure and on-premises systems**: Microsoft 365 Copilot does not automatically grant Azure RBAC to a user. Agents, plugins, and connectors may connect to external APIs, but their reach depends on the configured identity and authorization. Copilot is a retrieval layer, not an implicit cross-boundary grant.

text.zh: Microsoft 365 Copilot 对组织数据的访问通常遵循用户现有权限；扩展智能体和连接器的行为还取决于其身份与连接配置。它会更快汇总用户可访问的数据，因此权限审计与扩展配置都是必需项——权限审计从可拖延的工程，变成了随时会被一句提示兑现的债。
text.en: Microsoft 365 Copilot generally follows the user's existing permissions for organizational data. Agents and connectors depend on their own identities and connection settings. Permission reviews and extension governance remain necessary because retrieval can make authorized content easier to aggregate.

text.zh: 4.3 观测面
text.en: 4.3 Observability

text.zh: Microsoft Purview Audit 会记录受支持 Copilot 与 AI 应用的交互事件，包括用户、时间、交互位置及访问资源等信息；Copilot 交互审计记录还可包含提示与响应消息信息。实际可检索内容、保留期限及 eDiscovery 可用性取决于具体 Copilot 产品、许可、审计配置和适用的保留策略——不能假设所有 AI 交互都以相同方式或期限保存。微软也提供面向 AI 场景的数据安全治理能力（DSPM for AI）。AI 交互有日志可查，但“有日志”不等于“查得到”——做合规审查时要按产品的审计覆盖与保留期分别核对。
text.en: Purview Audit records supported Copilot and AI application events, which may include the user, time, interaction location, and accessed resources. Some records can include prompt and response information. Searchability, retention, and eDiscovery availability depend on the Copilot product, licensing, audit configuration, and retention policies. Verify the coverage for each product rather than assuming all AI interactions are retained identically. Microsoft also provides data-security capabilities for AI scenarios, including DSPM for AI.

text.zh: 五、安全栈拆解：Sentinel、Purview、Defender、Intune
text.en: 5. Security services: Sentinel, Purview, Defender, and Intune

text.zh: 5.1 Microsoft Sentinel
text.en: 5.1 Microsoft Sentinel

text.zh: Sentinel 是云原生 SIEM，在多云多平台环境里提供可扩展、高性价比的安全能力，结合 AI、自动化与威胁情报支撑威胁检测、调查、响应与主动狩猎。
text.en: Sentinel is a cloud-native SIEM for threat detection, investigation, response, and hunting in multicloud and multiplatform environments. It stores data in a Log Analytics workspace. Its access depends on workspace, subscription, and Sentinel roles. Entra ID, Azure Activity, Microsoft 365 audit, and Defender alerts can be ingested through data connectors.

text.zh: 它与 Azure 的关系是：Sentinel 是 Azure 服务，数据存储在 Log Analytics 工作区；启用和管理权限取决于工作区、订阅与 Sentinel 的角色配置。它与 M365 的关系靠数据连接器：Entra ID、Azure Activity、M365 审计、Defender 告警等可以通过连接器送入工作区。Sentinel 已在 Defender 门户正式可用；截至本文更新时，Azure 门户体验计划于 2027 年 3 月 31 日后停止支持。自 2025 年 7 月起，符合条件的新客户工作区会在启用 Sentinel 时自动接入 Defender 门户；相关条件包括订阅 Owner 或 User Access Administrator 权限，且不是 Azure Lighthouse 委托用户。Defender 门户中的安全访问可由统一 RBAC（URBAC）管理，Azure 资源本身仍受 Azure RBAC 控制。
text.en: Sentinel is available in the Defender portal; the Azure portal experience is scheduled to stop being supported after March 31, 2027. Since July 2025, eligible new customer workspaces are automatically connected to the Defender portal when Sentinel is enabled. Eligibility includes required subscription permissions and excludes Azure Lighthouse delegated users. Defender portal access can use Unified RBAC; Azure resources themselves remain governed by Azure RBAC.

text.zh: 两个必须记住的细节。其一，角色分配是累积的——一个同时持有 Sentinel Reader 与（Azure）Contributor 的用户，实际权限可能超出预期；清点 Sentinel 的权限不能只看 Sentinel 专属角色，要并上 Azure 侧的通用角色与 Log Analytics 角色。其二，数据完整性：Sentinel 继承 Azure Monitor 的防篡改与不可变实践，Azure Monitor 是仅追加的数据平台，但为合规目的保留了删除条款——日志不是绝对动不了，删除的通道存在，只是被设计得很窄。此外 Sentinel 支持 Lighthouse 跨租户管理，托管安全服务这个形态本身也是一条需要识别的跨租户通道。
text.en: Two details matter in access reviews. Role assignments are cumulative, so combine Sentinel roles with Azure Contributor and Log Analytics roles when assessing effective access. Data protection follows Azure Monitor's append-oriented model, but deletion paths remain available for compliance purposes; logs are not absolutely immutable. Sentinel also supports Lighthouse cross-tenant management, which should be included in the cross-tenant inventory.

text.zh: Sentinel 的权限价值分两条线。一条是取证：持有相应读取权限时，工作区查询是最快的“历史复盘”入口——登录日志、告警、实体关系一次查完。另一条是规则面：持有 Sentinel Contributor 及以上角色的人可以改分析规则、关规则、删事件、改自动化规则与 playbook。被改了阈值的分析规则比没有告警更危险，因为它看起来还在工作；而“改规则”这个动作本身，只有被另一层监控（对 Sentinel 自身的变更审计）覆盖时才会暴露——这正是“检测的检测”该覆盖的位置。
text.en: Sentinel permissions have both investigative and configuration effects. Read permissions allow workspace queries; Sentinel Contributor and higher roles may modify analytics rules, automation rules, and playbooks. Rule changes should be monitored independently from the alerts those rules produce.

text.zh: 5.2 Microsoft Purview
text.en: 5.2 Microsoft Purview

text.zh: Purview 是合规平面，解决方案覆盖统一审计、eDiscovery（标准与高级）、DLP、内部风险管理、通信合规、数据生命周期与记录管理，以及面向 AI 的数据安全治理。内部风险管理的定位：关联多种信号以识别潜在恶意或无意内部风险（知识产权窃取、数据泄露、违规行为），默认对用户做假名化，配合 RBAC 与审计日志实现隐私设计。
text.en: Purview provides compliance capabilities including audit, eDiscovery Standard and Premium, DLP, Insider Risk Management, communication compliance, data lifecycle and records management, and AI data-security governance. Insider Risk Management correlates signals to identify potential malicious or accidental risks and uses pseudonymization by default, alongside role-based access and audit.

text.zh: 权限侧的事实：Purview eDiscovery Manager 角色组可让成员在组织范围内搜索其获授权的内容位置并导出结果，具体权限受案例成员资格和搜索范围过滤等设置约束。应用专用认证运行 Security & Compliance PowerShell 的 eDiscovery cmdlet 属于不支持的场景；Microsoft 建议在可用时迁移到 Microsoft Graph API，现存自动化说明只能作为尽力而为的兼容指导。Entra 内置角色 Purview Workload Content Administrator 可从 Purview 门户管理或清除 M365 数据；这一高权限角色也应纳入最小权限和审计范围。
text.en: The eDiscovery Manager role group can search and export authorized content locations, subject to case membership and search-scope filters. Application-only authentication for eDiscovery PowerShell cmdlets is not a supported scenario; Microsoft recommends Microsoft Graph APIs where available. Existing automation guidance should be treated as compatibility information rather than a guarantee. The Entra role Purview Workload Content Administrator can manage or purge Microsoft 365 data from the Purview portal and should be subject to least privilege and audit.

text.zh: Purview 的关键词是“批量”与“合规出口”。eDiscovery 的搜索与导出按设计就是要把内容成规模地筛出来交给人——一个拿到 eDiscovery Manager 的身份，可以不碰任何邮箱或站点权限就完成成规模的内容导出；导出本身是审计事件，但“导出”这个动作在大型组织里并不罕见，异常与否取决于基线。反方向的清单同样具体：DLP 与保留策略覆盖哪些通道、豁免了哪些账号，决定了 M365 侧数据面的剩余宽度——这些策略配置本身也是需要纳入治理的资产。
text.en: eDiscovery is an authorized bulk-export capability. Review role assignments, case membership, scope filters, DLP, and retention exemptions; compare search and export activity with a workload-specific baseline.

text.zh: 5.3 Microsoft Defender XDR
text.en: 5.3 Microsoft Defender XDR

text.zh: Defender XDR 是统一的击前击后企业防御套件，原生集成端点、身份、邮件与应用。拆开是几个组件：Defender for Endpoint（端点检测与响应，Live Response 提供远程会话——基础命令包括列目录、列进程、下载文件，高级命令包括网络隔离、运行脚本库中的 PowerShell、采集取证包、清除实体，高级命令受角色控制）；Defender for Office 365（邮件安全）；Defender for Identity（在本地 AD 部署传感器，把上一篇那些 Kerberos 与身份攻击的检测接进云端门户——本地与云在这里交汇）；Defender for Cloud Apps（SaaS 与影子 IT）；Azure 侧另有 Defender for Cloud。
text.en: Defender XDR integrates endpoint, identity, email, and application protection. Its components include Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity, and Defender for Cloud Apps. Defender for Endpoint Live Response provides remote investigation capabilities, with advanced actions controlled by roles. Defender for Identity sensors operate in on-premises Active Directory and connect on-premises identity signals with the cloud portal. Azure workloads have the separate Defender for Cloud service.

text.zh: 它与其他服务的集成关系构成一张网：与 Sentinel 用连接器互通告警；与 Intune 互通设备管理与策略下发（安全设置管理允许在 Defender 门户管理安全策略而无需完整 Intune 注册）；与条件访问互通——Defender for Endpoint 的设备风险信号进入条件访问评估，把“端点安全状态”变成访问控制信号。
text.en: These services integrate with Sentinel through connectors, with Intune for device management and policy, and with Conditional Access through device-risk signals from Defender for Endpoint. This allows endpoint security posture to inform access decisions.

text.zh: Defender XDR 最值得先记住的是 Live Response 的双面性：它的高级命令就是一套受控的远程执行能力——在授权角色手里是调查工具，在失陷的同等权限手里就是“通过官方通道在端点执行脚本、取文件、采集取证包”的通道，甚至包括把设备从网络隔离。检测侧对应的是 Defender 角色分配与 Live Response 会话记录，是很有分量的事件。另一个单独值得注意的组件是 Defender for Identity——它的传感器在本地 AD，意味着上篇里 Kerberos 票据与委派那几节的手法在这里有对应的告警名；它的安全评估项（包括对 AZUREADSSOACC 委派配置的检查）恰好就是上篇“委派盘点”那四处的官方巡检清单。做混合链评估时，把 MDI 的检测矩阵放在手边，逐条对一下要审计的手法会落在哪个阶段。
text.en: Live Response is a privileged remote investigation capability. Review role assignments and session records, and monitor changes to Defender configuration. Defender for Identity's assessments can also help review on-premises configurations such as AZUREADSSOACC delegation.

text.zh: 安全栈的控制面本身就是高价值目标：能改 Sentinel 分析规则的人能制造盲区，能操作 Defender 与 Intune 的人握着隔离与设备动作，能管 Purview 的人掌握审计与证据。清点这些角色（URBAC、Sentinel Contributor、Defender 门户角色、Intune RBAC、Purview 角色组）与清点业务权限同等重要。
text.en: The security control plane itself needs governance. Sentinel rule editors, Defender and Intune operators, and Purview administrators can affect detection, response, devices, and evidence. Review their role assignments and audit records as carefully as business-data permissions.

text.zh: 5.4 Intune 与 MDM
text.en: 5.4 Intune and MDM

text.zh: 先把概念分开：MDM（移动设备管理）是一种能力——设备注册、策略下发、合规上报；Intune 是微软的 MDM 实现，同时也是 M365 的端点管理服务。像 Intune 这样的 MDM 方案可以设定设备必须满足的规则并上报合规状态，这就是合规策略；把合规策略与条件访问结合后，就能要求设备满足安全要求才能访问组织数据。
text.en: Mobile device management (MDM) is a capability for device enrollment, policy deployment, and compliance reporting. Intune is Microsoft's MDM implementation and endpoint-management service. Conditional Access can require a device to meet security requirements before it accesses organizational data.

text.zh: 条件访问那一侧的信号清单是：用户或组成员身份、IP 位置信息、设备细节（合规或配置状态）、应用细节（是否要求受管应用）、以及配合移动威胁防御伙伴的实时与计算风险检测。Intune 对这套体系的贡献，是给这个能力加上移动设备合规与移动应用管理数据。
text.en: Conditional Access can consider user or group membership, IP location, device compliance or configuration, application details, and signals from supported mobile threat-defense partners. Intune supplies device-compliance and mobile-application-management information.

text.zh: Intune 的管理动作叫设备动作：擦除、停用、删除、远程锁定、重启、重置密码、远程协助——具体动作因设备平台和管理状态而异，每一种都受 Intune RBAC 角色、权限与范围约束。与 Entra 的关系：设备对象在目录里，注册发生在 Entra，合规状态写回设备对象，条件访问在 Entra 里启用。与 Defender 的关系上一节说过：设备风险接条件访问，Intune 负责部署与策略。
text.en: Intune device actions include wipe, retire, delete, remote lock, restart, password reset, and remote assistance, depending on platform and enrollment state. Each action is constrained by Intune RBAC, permissions, and scope. Device objects reside in Entra, enrollment is recorded there, and compliance state can inform Conditional Access. Defender device-risk signals can also influence access.

text.zh: Intune 有两条值得单列的治理面。其一是“下发能力”：Intune 的脚本与配置下发机制本身就是一条官方的代码投递通道——控制它的人可以在受管设备上执行代码，而这类动作在端点日志里未必显眼。其二是“合规姿态”：能改合规策略或设备记录的人，可以改变设备进入组织数据的门槛——让不合规的设备看起来合规。前者是横向移动与驻留的候选通道，后者是绕过设备条件访问的候选通道，两条都应写进影响评估，而不是只写“拿到了控制台权限”。
text.en: Intune governance includes policy and software deployment as well as compliance state. Changes to scripts, configurations, compliance policies, and device records should be managed and audited because they can affect device security and access decisions.

text.zh: 5.5 拆解之后
text.en: 5.5 Putting the services together

text.zh: 四个服务放进同一张图，就是第二、三节的平面图加上执行层：Sentinel 站在 Azure 订阅里观测两个平面；Purview 站在合规平面横跨两边的内容；Defender XDR 站在防护平面横跨端点、邮件、身份与本地 AD；Intune 站在设备平面把终端状态翻译成条件访问的信号。它们互不隶属，靠连接器与共享的 Entra 身份平面咬合。这层拆解的价值在于：每进入一层，掌握的不止是“更多数据”，而是“别人看数据的眼睛”——观测面本身也是需要治理的领地。
text.en: Sentinel operates in Azure subscriptions and observes both Microsoft 365 and Azure signals. Purview provides compliance and content-governance capabilities across supported workloads. Defender XDR covers endpoints, email, identity, applications, and on-premises Active Directory; Intune manages devices and reports compliance. These services are distinct and connect through data connectors and the shared Entra identity plane. Their own administrative roles and configuration surfaces are part of the security boundary.

text.zh: 六、核验清单：M365 与安全栈
text.en: 6. Review checklist: Microsoft 365 and the security stack

text.zh: 按层把值得核验的配置与通道排一遍，全部是前面各节展开过的机制的名字化版本，逐项在环境中验证“存在或不存在”：
text.en: The following checklist consolidates the configuration areas discussed above:

items.zh: 身份层：密码喷洒与令牌重放的暴露面、设备代码钓鱼的同意面、PRT 保护（上篇）、同意钓鱼的门与墙（用户级与管理员级）、应用注册凭据的新增与轮换记录、PIM 激活策略。
items.en: **Identity:** password-spray and token-replay exposure, device-code consent, PRT protections, user and administrator consent, application credential additions and rotation, and PIM activation policies.

items.zh: 邮箱层：Graph 应用权限的实际授权范围（受范围控制约束）、收件箱规则与转发配置、eDiscovery 的案例范围与导出基线、委托与邮箱权限的分布。
items.en: **Mail:** Graph application-permission scope, mailbox rules and forwarding, eDiscovery case scope and export baselines, and mailbox delegation.

items.zh: 文件层：Graph 文件权限的授权范围、站点集管理员清单、“任何人链接”与 guest 清单、断继承站点清单、以用户视角重测的可见面。
items.en: **Files:** Graph file permissions, site-collection administrators, anyone links and guests, sites with broken inheritance, and user-perspective access checks.

items.zh: 协作层：共享频道的跨租户访问设置、Teams 联邦与 guest 策略、频道消息类应用权限。
items.en: **Collaboration:** shared-channel cross-tenant settings, Teams federation and guest policies, and message-related application permissions.

items.zh: AI 层：隐藏文本/批注/元数据/替代文字这类注入载体的处理策略、智能体身份与连接清单、连接器数据源清单、Copilot 审计记录的覆盖与保留。
items.en: **AI:** handling of hidden text and document metadata, agent identities and connections, connector data sources, and Copilot audit coverage and retention.

items.zh: 安全栈层：Sentinel 分析规则的变更审计、playbook 的权限边界、工作区查询的读取权限分布、Purview eDiscovery 的导出基线、Defender Live Response 的角色分配与会话记录、Intune 脚本下发与合规策略的变更管理。
items.en: **Security stack:** Sentinel analytics-rule change auditing, playbook permissions, workspace query access, eDiscovery export baselines, Defender Live Response roles and sessions, and Intune script and compliance-policy changes.

text.zh: 这张清单不是操作手册，是做环境盘点时的对照表：每一项在目标环境里要么存在、要么不存在，不存在本身就是一条结论。
text.en: This is a review checklist, not an operating procedure. Verify each item against the organization's actual configuration and document whether it is present.

text.zh: 七、收束：从 M365 到 Azure 到本地
text.en: 7. From Microsoft 365 to Azure and on-premises

text.zh: 两篇合起来，完整的访问与审查链收在一处：
text.en: The combined access model can be summarized as follows:

text.zh:
（身份入手）
   用户 / 应用凭据 / 设备（PRT）
        │
        ├─ Entra 角色 ──► 目录与安全栈控制面（GA→elevateAccess→Azure）
        ├─ Graph 应用权限 ──► 经同意的 M365 API 数据（范围取决于权限与资源范围控制）
        ├─ 工作负载 RBAC ──► eDiscovery 导出 / 委托 / 站点管理
        │        └─► Copilot：可见面的一次性兑现（放大器，不是新边界）
        ├─ Azure RBAC ──► 资源平面（托管标识 / IMDS / 订阅）
        └─ 混合链 ──► PHS / PTA / ADFS / SSO / 委派 ⇄ 本地域控（见上篇）
（观测与审查）
   Sentinel（Azure 订阅里的工作区）· Purview（审计/eDiscovery）· Defender（URBAC/Live Response）· Intune（设备动作）
text.en:
（身份入手）
   用户 / 应用凭据 / 设备（PRT）
        │
        ├─ Entra 角色 ──► 目录与安全栈控制面（GA→elevateAccess→Azure）
        ├─ Graph 应用权限 ──► 经同意的 M365 API 数据（范围取决于权限与资源范围控制）
        ├─ 工作负载 RBAC ──► eDiscovery 导出 / 委托 / 站点管理
        │        └─► Copilot：可见面的一次性兑现（放大器，不是新边界）
        ├─ Azure RBAC ──► 资源平面（托管标识 / IMDS / 订阅）
        └─ 混合链 ──► PHS / PTA / ADFS / SSO / 委派 ⇄ 本地域控（见上篇）
（观测与审查）
   Sentinel（Azure 订阅里的工作区）· Purview（审计/eDiscovery）· Defender（URBAC/Live Response）· Intune（设备动作）

text.zh: 本篇的要点收成下面十几句：
text.en: The main conclusions are:

items.zh: M365 的认证主要由 Entra 承担；访问评估要分别看 Entra 角色、工作负载权限、应用同意，以及条件访问使用的设备合规信号。
items.en: Microsoft 365 authentication is primarily handled by Entra; access reviews should separate Entra roles, workload permissions, application consent, and device-compliance signals.

items.zh: M365 与 Azure 共享身份平面，各自拥有授权平面；安全栈横跨两边，且往往住在 Azure 订阅里。
items.en: Microsoft 365 and Azure share identity but have separate authorization planes. Security services can span both and often depend on Azure subscriptions.

items.zh: Graph 应用权限是 M365 的重要应用访问面；授权范围取决于具体权限和已配置的资源范围控制，评估时看“同意到了哪一步”而不是“有没有登录”。
items.en: Graph application permissions are a major workload access path; review granted scopes and resource-scope controls.

items.zh: ApplicationImpersonation 已退役；应用访问邮箱走 Graph 应用权限加范围控制——旧角色残留是单独的清点项。
items.en: ApplicationImpersonation is retired; review any remaining legacy applications and their migration.

items.zh: Copilot 对组织数据的访问通常遵循用户现有权限；它不改变权限，只加速汇聚——暴露的是权限债。
items.en: Copilot generally follows user permissions and can make existing oversharing easier to discover.

items.zh: 间接注入的载体是“用户会读到的内容”：隐藏文本、批注、元数据、图片替代文字都算候选。
items.en: Indirect prompt injection can enter through content that the user or connected service can retrieve; product safeguards are one defense layer.

items.zh: 智能体与连接器增加了数据访问和操作面；它们使用的身份与权限取决于产品类型和配置，每一个都值得按服务账号的标准盘一遍。
items.en: Agents and connectors have identities and connections that vary by product and configuration.

items.zh: Copilot 不会自动授予 Azure RBAC；扩展组件能否访问 Azure 或本地资源取决于其连接身份与授权——Copilot 是放大器，不是边界突破器。
items.en: Copilot does not automatically grant Azure RBAC; external access depends on the connector identity and authorization.

items.zh: Sentinel 工作区与数据访问涉及 Azure RBAC 与 Defender 门户的统一 RBAC，且角色分配是累积的；改规则比删日志更隐蔽。
items.en: Sentinel uses Azure RBAC and Defender portal RBAC; effective access is cumulative, and analytics-rule changes need monitoring.

items.zh: eDiscovery 是成规模的官方导出出口，范围受案例成员资格与搜索过滤约束；“导出”是否异常取决于基线。
items.en: eDiscovery is an authorized export path, governed by case membership and search filters.

items.zh: Defender for Identity 的传感器在本地 AD——本地票据与委派攻击在这里有对应的告警名，混合链评估要对表。
items.en: Defender for Identity provides visibility into on-premises Active Directory and should be considered in hybrid reviews.

items.zh: Intune 的脚本下发与合规姿态是设备面通往数据面的两条正式通道。
items.en: Intune controls device actions and compliance signals that can affect access.

items.zh: 访问链上每一环的观测点都在安全栈里；而安全栈自身的角色分配，就是这条链上最后一块需要治理的领地。
items.en: The roles and configurations that operate the security stack are themselves part of the control plane.
